english_key: The specialist warned that the treatment could cause side effects, although not all patients would experience them.
acceptables: The specialist cautioned that the treatment might produce side effects, although not all patients would experience them.
The specialist warned that the treatment could have side effects, though not every patient would experience them.

traps.comment: advertir = warn / caution. 'Advise' means recommend; the warning disappears.
traps.label: advertir rendered as advise
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: no todos = not all (partial). 'All patients would not' reads as 'none'.
traps.label: partial negation became total
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Ni la antigüedad del inmueble ni su valor comercial bastan por sí solos para determinar si debe ser declarado patrimonio cultural.
errors_to_catch: plural verb with neither… nor + singular
why_this_chunk: Neither… nor with singular subjects → singular verb; inmueble = property / building.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ni… ni… bastan: with neither… nor + singular nouns, which verb form? What is inmueble?
english_key: Neither the age of the property nor its market value is sufficient in itself to determine whether it should be declared cultural heritage.
acceptables: Neither the age of the building nor its commercial value is sufficient on its own to determine whether it should be designated cultural heritage.
Neither the age of the property nor its market value alone is enough to determine whether it should be declared a heritage site.

traps.comment: ni… ni = neither… nor. 'Neither… or' is a nonparallel pair.
traps.ok: Neither the age of the property nor
traps.no: Neither the age of the property or
traps.label: neither paired with or
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: With neither… nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (its market value → is).
traps.label: plural verb with neither… nor + singular
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: patrimonio cultural = cultural heritage. 'Patrimony' is inheritance from a father.
traps.label: patrimonio rendered as patrimony
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Como consecuencia de los cambios introducidos en el procedimiento, algunas solicitudes que antes se resolvían en días ahora tardan semanas.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: used to + verb for past habit; restrictive 'that' clause with no comma.
suggested_ok_english_hint: que antes se resolvían: a past habit. Which English form? Which applications?
english_key: As a result of the changes made to the procedure, some applications that used to be resolved in days now take weeks.
acceptables: As a consequence of the changes introduced in the procedure, some applications that were previously resolved in a matter of days now take weeks.
Because of the changes made to the procedure, some requests that used to be processed in days now take weeks.

traps.comment: antes se resolvían = used to be resolved / were previously resolved. 'Resolved before' blurs the habit.
traps.label: past habit lost
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: The clause identifies which applications; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: La comisión resolvió aplazar la votación hasta que sus integrantes hubieran tenido oportunidad de examinar las observaciones pendientes.
why_this_chunk: Past perfect after until in a past context (had had); integrantes = members.
suggested_ok_english_hint: hasta que hubieran tenido: the past perfect in the until-clause. What are integrantes?
english_key: The commission decided to postpone the vote until its members had had an opportunity to examine the outstanding comments.
acceptables: The commission resolved to postpone the vote until its members had had a chance to review the pending observations.
The commission decided to defer the vote until its members had been given the opportunity to examine the outstanding comments.

detector.pattern: \buntil its members would have\b|\buntil its members would\b

traps.comment: No 'would' after until: 'until its members had had an opportunity'.
traps.no: until its members would have had
traps.label: conditional in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: integrantes = members.
traps.label: integrantes calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: De los empleados que asistieron a la capacitación, menos de la mitad completó satisfactoriamente las pruebas de evaluación.
why_this_chunk: asistir = attend; capacitación = training; 'fewer than half' (countable employees).
suggested_ok_english_hint: asistieron = attended. capacitación = ? menos de la mitad + singular in Spanish: English agreement?
english_key: Of the employees who attended the training, fewer than half successfully completed the assessment tests.
acceptables: Of the employees who attended the training session, less than half satisfactorily completed the evaluation tests.
Of the employees who took the training, fewer than half successfully passed the assessment tests.

traps.comment: asistir a = attend.
traps.label: asistir rendered as assist
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: capacitación = training.
traps.label: capacitación calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Lejos de solucionar el problema, la decisión generó nuevas dudas sobre las facultades de la autoridad que la había adoptado.
why_this_chunk: Lejos de = far from; facultades = powers.
suggested_ok_english_hint: facultades = powers / authority, not faculties. Which authority? (restrictive)
english_key: Far from solving the problem, the decision raised new doubts about the powers of the authority that had made it.
acceptables: Far from resolving the problem, the decision raised new questions about the authority of the body that had adopted it.
Far from solving the problem, the decision generated new doubts about the powers of the authority that had taken it.

traps.comment: facultades (legal) = powers / authority. 'Faculties' are mental abilities or university staff.
traps.label: facultades rendered as faculties
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Lejos de = Far from.
traps.label: wrong preposition
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El documento puede consultarse gratuitamente en línea, pero las copias certificadas deberán solicitarse en la oficina correspondiente.
why_this_chunk: gratuitamente = free of charge; comma before but joining two clauses.
suggested_ok_english_hint: gratuitamente = free of charge, not gratuitously. Keep the two clauses balanced.
english_key: The document can be consulted online free of charge, but certified copies must be requested at the appropriate office.
acceptables: The document may be viewed online free of charge, but certified copies must be requested from the relevant office.
The document is available online for free, but certified copies will have to be requested at the corresponding office.

traps.comment: gratuitamente = free of charge. 'Gratuitously' means without reason.
traps.label: gratuitamente rendered as gratuitously
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma need 'but'; dropping it makes a splice.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

spanish_text: En ningún caso se entenderá que la falta de respuesta implica la aceptación automática de las condiciones propuestas.
why_this_chunk: Fronted negative + inversion (Under no circumstances shall…); legal 'shall'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: En ningún caso + se entenderá: a legal prohibition. Keep the negation and the fronted-negative inversion.
english_key: Under no circumstances shall failure to respond be construed as automatic acceptance of the proposed terms.
acceptables: Under no circumstances shall a failure to respond be understood to imply automatic acceptance of the proposed conditions.
In no case shall the lack of a response be deemed to constitute automatic acceptance of the proposed terms.

traps.comment: En ningún caso = Under no circumstances. Dropping it reverses the rule.
traps.label: negation lost
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: ^\s*(under no circumstances|in no case),? (failure|the failure|a failure|the lack)\b

traps.comment: A fronted negative requires inversion: 'Under no circumstances shall failure to respond be construed…'.
traps.no: Under no circumstances failure to respond shall
traps.label: no inversion
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Por primera vez desde que comenzó el seguimiento, el número de reclamaciones disminuyó tanto en las ciudades como en las zonas rurales.
errors_to_catch: both… as well as / both… as
why_this_chunk: Both… and parallel; 'the number of' singular; reclamaciones = complaints.
suggested_ok_english_hint: 'The number of complaints' + verb: singular. tanto… como…: both… and.
english_key: For the first time since monitoring began, the number of complaints decreased in both cities and rural areas.
acceptables: For the first time since monitoring began, the number of complaints fell both in cities and in rural areas.
For the first time since tracking started, the number of complaints declined in both urban and rural areas.

traps.comment: tanto… como = both… and. 'Both… as well as' and 'both X as Y' are nonparallel.
traps.ok: in both cities and rural areas
traps.no: in both cities as well as rural areas
traps.label: both… as well as / both… as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: reclamación = complaint / claim. 'Reclamation' means recovering land or materials.
traps.label: reclamación rendered as reclamation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: 'The number of…' takes a singular verb.
traps.no: the number of complaints were decreasing
traps.label: agreement with the number of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: La autoridad explicó que realizar una inspección adicional no necesariamente implicaba retrasar la entrega de las instalaciones.
why_this_chunk: realizar ≠ realize; keep 'not necessarily'; instalaciones = facilities.
suggested_ok_english_hint: realizar = carry out. no necesariamente = a hedge. instalaciones = facilities.
english_key: The authority explained that carrying out an additional inspection did not necessarily mean delaying the handover of the facilities.
acceptables: The authority explained that conducting an additional inspection did not necessarily imply a delay in the delivery of the facilities.
The authority explained that an additional inspection would not necessarily mean delaying the handover of the facilities.

traps.comment: realizar = carry out / conduct / make. 'Realize' means to become aware of something.
traps.label: realizar rendered as realize
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: no necesariamente = not necessarily. The hedge must survive.
traps.label: hedge omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: instalaciones (building) = facilities.
traps.label: instalaciones rendered as installations
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: De manera similar, quienes recibieron el subsidio el año anterior deberán demostrar que siguen cumpliendo las condiciones para conservarlo.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: Comma after the introductory transition; restrictive who-clause.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De manera similar: introductory transition + comma. Which people? siguen cumpliendo = still meet.
english_key: Similarly, those who received the subsidy the previous year must prove that they still meet the conditions to keep it.
acceptables: Likewise, those who received the subsidy the year before will have to show that they continue to meet the conditions for keeping it.
Similarly, people who received the subsidy last year must demonstrate that they still fulfill the conditions required to retain it.

traps.comment: Put a comma after an introductory transitional word.
traps.label: missing comma after introductory word
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Commas: Introductory words and phrases, p. 19

traps.comment: The clause identifies which people; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: No fue la falta de recursos lo que provocó el retraso, sino la demora en obtener los permisos exigidos por la normativa vigente.
why_this_chunk: It was not X that… but Y; normativa vigente = current regulations (not 'vigent').
suggested_ok_english_hint: No fue… lo que… sino…: a cleft with contrast. vigente = current. Keep the not… but pair.
english_key: It was not the lack of resources that caused the delay, but the delay in obtaining the permits required by current regulations.
acceptables: It was not the lack of resources that caused the delay but the time it took to obtain the permits required under current regulations.
The delay was caused not by a lack of resources but by the slowness in obtaining the permits required by the regulations in force.

traps.comment: no fue… sino… = it was not… but…. 'If not' is a calque.
traps.no: if not the delay in obtaining
traps.label: sino mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: normativa vigente = current regulations. 'Actual' means real, not current.
traps.label: vigente rendered as actual
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Ya sea por dificultades técnicas o por falta de coordinación, el proyecto acumuló retrasos que no estaban contemplados en el cronograma inicial.
why_this_chunk: whether X or Y (parallel); cronograma = timeline / schedule.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ya sea por… o por…: whether… or… with parallel halves. cronograma = ?
english_key: Whether because of technical difficulties or a lack of coordination, the project accumulated delays that had not been anticipated in the initial timeline.
acceptables: Whether due to technical difficulties or to a lack of coordination, the project accumulated delays that were not foreseen in the original schedule.
Whether as a result of technical problems or poor coordination, the project suffered delays that had not been contemplated in the initial timeline.

traps.comment: cronograma = schedule / timeline.
traps.label: cronograma rendered as chronogram
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Ya sea por… o por… = Whether because of… or…. A word-for-word calque is unreadable.
traps.label: ya sea calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: no estaban contemplados: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La compañía anunció que eventualmente podría ampliar sus operaciones, pero aclaró que todavía no había tomado una decisión definitiva.
why_this_chunk: eventualmente ≠ eventually; US 'make a decision'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: eventualmente = possibly / at some point, not 'eventually' (= in the end, for sure). tomar una decisión = make (US).
english_key: The company announced that it might expand its operations at some point but made clear that it had not yet made a final decision.
acceptables: The company announced that it could possibly expand its operations, but it clarified that it had not yet made a final decision.
The company announced that it might expand its operations in the future but made it clear that it had not yet reached a definitive decision.

traps.comment: eventualmente = possibly / at some point. 'Eventually' means in the end (it will happen), which overstates the source.
traps.label: eventualmente rendered as eventually
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: US English: make a decision. 'Take a decision' is British usage.
traps.label: British take a decision
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: Los documentos que faltaban fueron entregados el lunes; los que ya obraban en el expediente no necesitaron presentarse nuevamente.
why_this_chunk: obrar en = be in / on file; semicolon between clauses; days capitalized.
suggested_ok_english_hint: obraban en el expediente = were in the file. Keep the semicolon. Days capitalized.
english_key: The missing documents were delivered on Monday; those already in the file did not need to be submitted again.
acceptables: The missing documents were submitted on Monday; the ones already on file did not have to be resubmitted.
The documents that were missing were delivered on Monday; those that were already in the case file did not need to be submitted again.

traps.comment: obrar en el expediente = be in / on file. 'Worked in the file' is nonsense.
traps.label: obrar mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Two independent clauses: keep the semicolon; a comma alone is a splice.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: English capitalizes days of the week (Monday).
traps.label: day lowercased
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El alcalde dijo que se habían adoptado medidas para reducir la contaminación, sin precisar cuáles habían sido sus resultados.
why_this_chunk: sin precisar = without specifying (the mayor); contaminación = pollution.
suggested_ok_english_hint: sin precisar: who did not specify? Make sure the modifier attaches to the mayor. contaminación = ?
english_key: The mayor said that measures had been taken to reduce pollution, without specifying what their results had been.
acceptables: The mayor said that measures had been adopted to reduce pollution but did not specify what the results had been.
The mayor stated that steps had been taken to reduce pollution, without specifying what results they had produced.

traps.comment: contaminación (air, environment) = pollution. 'Contamination' is narrower (food, water, radiation).
traps.label: contaminación rendered as contamination
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: sin precisar = without specifying.
traps.label: precisar mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A condición de que se mantengan los niveles actuales de financiación, el programa podría extenderse a otras cuatro regiones.
why_this_chunk: Present in the condition clause; 'four more / four other regions'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: A condición de que + subjunctive: which tense in the condition? otras cuatro regiones = ?
english_key: Provided that current funding levels are maintained, the program could be extended to four more regions.
acceptables: On condition that current funding levels are maintained, the program could be expanded to another four regions.
As long as the current levels of funding are maintained, the program could be extended to four other regions.

detector.pattern: \b(provided that|on condition that|as long as) (the )?current (funding )?levels (of funding )?(will|would) be\b

traps.comment: No will/would in the condition clause: 'Provided that current funding levels are maintained'.
traps.label: future in a condition clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: otras cuatro regiones = four more / four other / another four regions. 'Other four' is a calque.
traps.label: numeral after other
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: US target: program, not programme.
traps.label: programme (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: El informe distingue entre los costos que corresponden a la instalación y aquellos que surgirán durante la operación del sistema.
why_this_chunk: between X and Y (not 'between X or Y'); those that refers back to costs.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aquellos que = those that. Keep 'between X and Y' parallel.
english_key: The report distinguishes between the costs related to installation and those that will arise during the operation of the system.
acceptables: The report distinguishes between costs corresponding to installation and those that will arise while the system is in operation.
The report makes a distinction between the installation costs and the costs that will arise during system operation.

traps.comment: distinguish between X and Y. 'Between… or' and 'between… from' break the pair.
traps.label: between… or / from
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: aquellos que = those that (referring to costs).
traps.label: wrong referent pronoun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Anaphora / Referents, p. 8

spanish_text: Aun reconociendo los avances alcanzados, los expertos consideraron necesario revisar los indicadores utilizados para medir los resultados.
why_this_chunk: Concessive participle attached to the experts; 'considered it necessary' needs the dummy it.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Aun reconociendo: a concessive gerund with the experts as subject. consideraron necesario = considered it necessary.
english_key: While acknowledging the progress achieved, the experts considered it necessary to review the indicators used to measure the results.
acceptables: Although they acknowledged the progress made, the experts considered it necessary to revise the indicators used to measure the results.
Even while recognizing the progress that had been achieved, the experts deemed it necessary to review the indicators used to measure results.

traps.comment: consideraron necesario + inf. = considered it necessary to. English needs the dummy 'it'.
traps.label: missing dummy it
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: The concessive phrase must attach to the experts.
traps.no: it was considered by the experts
traps.label: dangling concessive phrase
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Dangling modifiers, p. 25

spanish_text: La nueva directora, junto con sus asesores, asistió a la reunión en la que se discutieron los principales desafíos del sector.
why_this_chunk: 'X, along with Y,' takes a singular verb; asistir = attend.
suggested_ok_english_hint: junto con: the verb agrees with 'director' (singular). asistió = attended. en la que = at which.
english_key: The new director, along with her advisers, attended the meeting at which the main challenges facing the sector were discussed.
acceptables: The new director, together with her advisors, attended the meeting in which the main challenges of the sector were discussed.
The new director, accompanied by her advisers, attended the meeting where the sector's main challenges were discussed.

traps.comment: The subject is 'the new director'; 'along with her advisers' is parenthetical and does not make it plural.
traps.label: plural verb with along with
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: asistir a = attend.
traps.label: asistir rendered as assist
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: La nueva directora: 'director' is neutral; 'her advisers' already shows gender.
traps.label: gender added
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: De acuerdo con las cifras oficiales, durante el segundo trimestre se recibieron 12.750 solicitudes, aproximadamente un tercio más que en el anterior.
errors_to_catch: decimal point used as thousands separator
why_this_chunk: US comma thousands separator (12,750); trimestre = quarter (not trimester).
suggested_ok_english_hint: 12.750: US thousands separator? trimestre = quarter. cifras = figures.
english_key: According to official figures, 12,750 applications were received in the second quarter, approximately a third more than in the previous quarter.
acceptables: According to official figures, 12,750 applications were received during the second quarter, about a third more than in the previous one.
According to the official figures, 12,750 applications were received in the second quarter, roughly one-third more than in the first quarter.

traps.comment: US English separates thousands with a comma: 12,750.
traps.label: decimal point used as thousands separator
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Numbers, p. 37

traps.comment: trimestre (fiscal) = quarter. 'Trimester' is used for pregnancy or school terms.
traps.label: trimestre rendered as trimester
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: cifras = figures.
traps.label: cifras rendered as ciphers
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No se había informado a los usuarios de los cambios ni se les había ofrecido un mecanismo para presentar observaciones.
why_this_chunk: not… or (shared negation); 'nor' needs inversion (nor had they…).
suggested_ok_english_hint: No se había informado… ni se les había ofrecido: after 'had not', or; or a new clause with 'nor had they'.
english_key: Users had not been informed of the changes or offered a mechanism for submitting comments.
acceptables: The users had not been informed of the changes, nor had they been offered a mechanism for submitting comments.
Users had neither been informed of the changes nor been given a way to submit comments.

traps.comment: After 'had not been informed', join with 'or'; 'nor' needs its own inverted clause ('nor had they been offered').
traps.label: nor after not without inversion
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: No se había informado: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: En principio, la medida se aplicará únicamente a las entidades públicas; no obstante, algunas empresas privadas podrían verse afectadas indirectamente.
why_this_chunk: only must survive; semicolon + however + comma.
suggested_ok_english_hint: únicamente: keep the restriction. ; no obstante, — semicolon before however.
english_key: In principle, the measure will apply only to public entities; however, some private companies could be indirectly affected.
acceptables: In principle, the measure will only apply to public agencies; however, some private companies may be affected indirectly.
In principle, the measure will apply exclusively to public bodies; nevertheless, some private companies could be indirectly affected.

traps.comment: únicamente limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: únicamente omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: 'However' between independent clauses needs a semicolon before it.
traps.label: comma splice before however
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Commas: Conjunctive adverbs, p. 18

spanish_text: El tribunal concluyó que la omisión no había sido intencional, aunque sí había impedido que los interesados ejercieran oportunamente su derecho de defensa.
why_this_chunk: impedir que = prevent… from -ing; US 'defense'; oportunamente = in a timely manner.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aunque sí había impedido: impedir que = prevent from. US spelling of defence?
english_key: The court concluded that the omission had not been intentional, although it had prevented the interested parties from exercising their right of defense in a timely manner.
acceptables: The court concluded that the omission had not been intentional, although it had indeed prevented the parties concerned from exercising their right to a defense in a timely manner.
The court found that the omission had not been intentional, even though it had prevented the interested parties from exercising their right of defense in due time.

traps.comment: US target: defense, not defence.
traps.label: defence (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: impedir que + subj. = prevent X from -ing. 'Prevented that' or 'prevented X to' is ungrammatical.
traps.ok: prevented the interested parties from exercising
traps.no: prevented the interested parties to exercise
traps.label: impedir que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: no había sido intencional: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La decisión de cerrar temporalmente la biblioteca, que fue anunciada el martes, sorprendió a los estudiantes que preparaban sus exámenes.
errors_to_catch: announcement attached to the wrong noun
commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: The decision was announced; recast so the English cannot attach 'announced' to the library. Which students? (restrictive)
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ambiguous source: 'que fue anunciada' could attach to la decisión or la biblioteca (both feminine). What was announced on Tuesday?
english_key: The decision, announced on Tuesday, to close the library temporarily surprised students who were preparing for their exams.
acceptables: The decision to temporarily close the library was announced on Tuesday and surprised the students who were studying for their exams.
The decision to close the library temporarily, which was announced on Tuesday, surprised students who were preparing for their exams.

traps.comment: Grammatical ambiguity in the source: make clear that the decision (not the library) was announced. 'The library, which was announced' can misread.
traps.ok: The decision, announced on Tuesday, to close the library
traps.no: The decision to close the library, which was announced on Tuesday,
traps.label: announcement attached to the wrong noun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Grammatical ambiguity in the source language, p. 26

traps.comment: The clause identifies which students; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: English capitalizes days of the week (Tuesday).
traps.label: day lowercased
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Más que una solución permanente, el nuevo esquema constituye una respuesta provisional a las dificultades identificadas durante la evaluación.
why_this_chunk: Más que = rather than; esquema = arrangement / plan (US 'scheme' has a negative connotation).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Más que = rather than. esquema in US English: plan / arrangement. 'Scheme' can sound shady.
english_key: Rather than a permanent solution, the new arrangement is a provisional response to the difficulties identified during the evaluation.
acceptables: Instead of a permanent solution, the new plan represents a temporary response to the difficulties identified during the assessment.
Rather than being a permanent solution, the new arrangement constitutes a provisional response to the difficulties identified in the evaluation.

traps.comment: esquema = arrangement / plan / system. In US English 'scheme' often implies a dishonest plan; British usage is neutral.
traps.label: scheme (negative in US usage)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

detector.pattern: ^\s*more than a permanent solution, the new (arrangement|plan|system) is\b

traps.comment: Más que = Rather than (substitution). 'More than a permanent solution, it is…' can read as 'in addition to'.
traps.label: más que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Puesto que el plazo vencía el viernes, los representantes solicitaron una prórroga que les permitiera reunir los documentos pendientes.
why_this_chunk: prórroga = extension; permitir needs an object (allow them to).
suggested_ok_english_hint: prórroga = extension (not prorogation). Puesto que = since / because.
english_key: Since the deadline was Friday, the representatives requested an extension that would allow them to gather the outstanding documents.
acceptables: Because the deadline expired on Friday, the representatives asked for an extension that would enable them to collect the pending documents.
As the deadline was on Friday, the representatives requested an extension so that they could gather the outstanding documents.

traps.comment: prórroga = extension. 'Prorogation' is the suspension of a parliament.
traps.label: prórroga rendered as prorogation
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Puesto que = Since / Because. A word-for-word calque is unreadable.
traps.label: puesto que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Cuando menos se esperaba, surgió una discrepancia entre el número de beneficiarios registrados y la cantidad de pagos efectivamente realizados.
errors_to_catch: cuando menos misread as at least
why_this_chunk: cuando menos se esperaba = when it was least expected; efectivamente = actually.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuando menos se esperaba: when least expected (not 'at least'). efectivamente realizados = actually made.
english_key: When it was least expected, a discrepancy emerged between the number of registered beneficiaries and the number of payments actually made.
acceptables: When it was least expected, a discrepancy arose between the number of registered beneficiaries and the number of payments actually made.
Just when it was least expected, a discrepancy appeared between the number of beneficiaries registered and the number of payments that had actually been made.

traps.comment: Cuando menos se esperaba = When it was least expected. Reading 'cuando menos' as 'at least' changes the meaning.
traps.label: cuando menos misread as at least
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: efectivamente realizados = actually made. 'Effectively' means efficiently or in effect.
traps.label: efectivamente rendered as effectively
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: realizar = carry out / conduct / make. 'Realize' means to become aware of something.
traps.label: realizar rendered as realize
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El estudio recomienda que se protejan los datos personales, se limite el acceso a la información y se establezcan mecanismos de supervisión.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive in all three items; keep the series parallel.
suggested_ok_english_hint: recomienda que se protejan… se limite… se establezcan: three parallel subjunctive passives.
english_key: The study recommends that personal data be protected, that access to information be limited, and that oversight mechanisms be established.
acceptables: The study recommends that personal data be protected, access to information be limited, and supervision mechanisms be established.
The study recommends protecting personal data, limiting access to information, and establishing oversight mechanisms.

detector.pattern: \bthat personal data (is|are|will be) protected\b|\bthat access to (the )?information (is|will be) limited\b|\bthat oversight mechanisms (are|will be) established\b

traps.comment: After recommend that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after recommend that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: Keep one structure for all three items (all 'that… be' or all gerunds).
traps.ok: that access to information be limited
traps.label: mixed forms in the series
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: Ni siquiera después de publicarse el informe quedó claro si las cifras incluían los gastos de mantenimiento o solo los de instalación.
why_this_chunk: Not even after… was it clear (inversion); keep 'only'; cifras = figures.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ni siquiera después de: negative scope plus inversion. Keep 'only'.
english_key: Not even after the report was published was it clear whether the figures included maintenance costs or only installation costs.
acceptables: Even after the report was published, it was still not clear whether the figures included maintenance costs or only installation costs.
Not even after the publication of the report did it become clear whether the figures included maintenance expenses or only installation expenses.

traps.comment: Ni siquiera… quedó claro = Not even after… was it clear. Losing the negation says it became clear.
traps.label: ni siquiera omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: solo limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solo omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: A fronted negative ('Not even after…') requires inversion: '…was it clear…'.
traps.label: no inversion
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Aunque la solicitud fue presentada oportunamente, su aprobación dependía de que se verificaran varios requisitos que aún no se habían acreditado.
why_this_chunk: depend on (not of); keep 'not yet'; acreditar = demonstrate / prove.
suggested_ok_english_hint: acreditar = prove / substantiate. aún no se habían acreditado: keep the negation and the past perfect.
english_key: Although the application was submitted on time, its approval depended on the verification of several requirements that had not yet been met.
acceptables: Although the application was filed in a timely manner, its approval was contingent on verifying several requirements that had not yet been satisfied.
Although the application had been submitted on time, its approval depended on several requirements being verified, which had not yet been demonstrated.

traps.comment: dependía de que = depended on (+ gerund / noun). 'Depended of' and 'depended that' are calques.
traps.label: wrong preposition after depend
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: aún no se habían acreditado: keep the negation.
traps.label: negation omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: acreditar requisitos = prove / demonstrate / show that requirements are met. 'Accredited' means officially recognized.
traps.label: acreditar rendered as accredited
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Aunque el museo había anunciado la restauración de la colección, no precisó cuáles de las piezas volverían a exhibirse ni cuándo estaría terminada la sala principal.
why_this_chunk: precisar = specify; after 'did not', ni becomes or; volver a exhibirse = be displayed again.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no precisó… ni cuándo: what does precisar mean, and which conjunction follows a negated verb in English?
english_key: Although the museum had announced the restoration of the collection, it did not specify which of the pieces would be put back on display or when the main gallery would be finished.
acceptables: Although the museum had announced that the collection would be restored, it did not specify which pieces would be exhibited again or when the main hall would be completed.
Although the museum had announced the restoration of the collection, it did not say which of the pieces would be displayed again or when the main exhibition hall would be completed.

traps.comment: precisar = specify / state precisely. 'Precise' is an adjective, not a verb.
traps.label: precisar rendered as 'did not precise'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: After a negated verb, ni = or. 'Did not X nor Y' is a double negative in US English; use 'or' or 'and did not'.
traps.label: not… nor
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: volverían a exhibirse = would be displayed again. Dropping 'again/back' loses the idea of a return to display.
traps.label: volver a omitted (again)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: De haber sabido que la carretera permanecería cerrada toda la semana, los transportistas habrían elegido otra ruta antes de cargar la mercancía.
focus: If… had, not if… would have
errors_to_catch: De haberse calqued as of having
why_this_chunk: De + perfect infinitive = Had they known / If they had known. Transportistas are truckers or carriers.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De haber sabido: how does English open an unreal past condition?
english_key: Had they known that the highway would remain closed all week, the truckers would have chosen another route before loading the goods.
acceptables: If they had known that the road would remain closed for the entire week, the carriers would have chosen a different route before loading the merchandise.
Had the truckers known that the highway would stay closed all week, they would have chosen another route before loading the cargo.

traps.comment: De + perfect infinitive = If… had… / Had…. 'Of having' is a word-for-word calque.
traps.label: De haberse calqued as of having
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: In an unreal past condition the if-clause takes the past perfect (If X had…), never would have.
traps.pitfall: If… had, not if… would have
traps.label: would have in the if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: transportistas = truckers / carriers / haulers. 'Transporters' is unidiomatic for people.
traps.label: transportistas rendered as 'the transporters'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El precio de los alimentos no solo depende del costo del transporte, sino también de la disponibilidad de productos y de la demanda de cada región.
why_this_chunk: Place not only right before the first element (on the cost) so that it mirrors but also on…
suggested_ok_english_hint: no solo depende… sino también: where does 'not only' go so both halves match?
english_key: The price of food depends not only on the cost of transportation but also on product availability and on demand in each region.
acceptables: Food prices depend not only on transportation costs but also on the availability of products and the demand in each region.
The price of food depends not only on the cost of transport but also on the availability of products and on demand in each region.

detector.pattern: \bnot only depends?\b|\bdoes not only depend\b|\bdo not only depend\b

traps.comment: no solo depende de X sino de Y: put 'not only' before 'on X' so it mirrors 'but also on Y'.
traps.label: not only misplaced (nonparallel)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: not only… must be completed by but (also). 'And also' breaks the pair.
traps.label: not only without but
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: Siempre que se respete la privacidad de los participantes, los investigadores podrán compartir los resultados con otras universidades sin solicitar una nueva autorización.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: siempre que + subjunctive = provided that / as long as; solicitar = request.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Siempre que + subjunctive: is this 'always' or a condition?
english_key: Provided that the participants' privacy is respected, the researchers may share the results with other universities without requesting new authorization.
acceptables: As long as the privacy of the participants is respected, the researchers will be able to share the results with other universities without requesting a new authorization.
Provided that participants' privacy is protected, researchers may share the results with other universities without seeking new authorization.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: solicitar una autorización = request / apply for authorization. 'Solicit' suggests canvassing or pestering.
traps.label: solicitar rendered as 'soliciting'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Quienes asistieron a la primera reunión recibieron un resumen de las propuestas, mientras que a los demás se les enviará la información por correo.
why_this_chunk: Keep the future tense; recast the Spanish indirect object as an English passive subject (the others will be sent).
suggested_ok_english_hint: enviará is future. And who is the subject of 'a los demás se les enviará'?
english_key: Those who attended the first meeting received a summary of the proposals, while the others will be sent the information by email.
acceptables: Those who attended the first meeting received a summary of the proposals, while the others will be sent the information by mail.
Those who attended the first meeting received a summary of the proposals, whereas the rest will receive the information by email.

traps.comment: se les enviará is future: the others have not received it yet.
traps.label: future rendered as past
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: Quienes asistieron = Those who attended. A bare 'Who attended…' is not an English subject.
traps.label: bare who as subject
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: a los demás se les enviará: English makes 'the others' the subject of a passive. 'To the others it will be sent' is a calque.
traps.no: to the others it will be sent
traps.label: indirect object calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Por muy atractiva que parezca la oferta, conviene leer las condiciones antes de aceptar un servicio que se renueva automáticamente.
why_this_chunk: Por muy atractiva que parezca = However attractive… may seem; conviene = it is advisable.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por muy… que: a concession. And what does conviene mean?
english_key: However attractive the offer may seem, it is advisable to read the terms before accepting a service that renews automatically.
acceptables: No matter how attractive the offer seems, it is a good idea to read the terms and conditions before accepting a service that is renewed automatically.
However appealing the offer may seem, it is wise to read the conditions before accepting a service that renews automatically.

traps.comment: Por muy + adj. + que = However + adj. / No matter how. 'For very attractive' is a calque.
traps.label: por muy… que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: conviene + inf. = it is advisable / it is a good idea. 'It is convenient' means easy or handy.
traps.label: conviene rendered as 'it is convenient'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No fue la lluvia sino la falta de señalización lo que impidió que los visitantes encontraran la entrada alternativa al parque.
why_this_chunk: It was not X but Y that…; impedir que = prevent from + -ing.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No fue X sino Y lo que…: what is the English cleft, and what does sino mean here?
english_key: It was not the rain but the lack of signage that prevented visitors from finding the alternate entrance to the park.
acceptables: It was not the rain but rather the lack of signs that kept visitors from finding the alternative entrance to the park.
It was the lack of signage, not the rain, that prevented visitors from finding the alternate entrance to the park.

detector.pattern: \bnot the rain,? if not\b|\bif not the lack\b

traps.comment: sino after a negative = but (rather). 'If not' (si no) changes the meaning.
traps.label: sino rendered as if not
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: impidió que + subjunctive = prevented X from + -ing. 'Prevented that…' is a calque.
traps.label: impedir que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: In an It was… cleft, English uses that, not what: It was the lack of signage that prevented….
traps.label: what in an it-cleft
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Apenas habían comenzado las entrevistas cuando se descubrió que varias preguntas podían inducir a los encuestados a responder de determinada manera.
why_this_chunk: Barely / hardly… when (not than); encuestados = respondents; determinada = particular / certain.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Apenas… cuando: barely/hardly pairs with which word?
english_key: The interviews had barely begun when it was discovered that several questions could lead respondents to answer in a particular way.
acceptables: The interviews had hardly begun when it was discovered that several questions might induce respondents to answer in a certain way.
Hardly had the interviews begun when it was discovered that several of the questions could lead respondents to answer in a certain way.

traps.comment: Apenas… cuando = barely / hardly… when. Only 'no sooner' takes than.
traps.label: barely… than
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: encuestados = respondents. 'The surveyed' is not idiomatic.
traps.label: encuestados rendered as 'lead the surveyed'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: de determinada manera = in a particular / certain way. 'Determined way' means resolute.
traps.label: determinado rendered as 'a determined way'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El escritor, cuya novela había sido rechazada por varias editoriales, consiguió finalmente publicarla sin renunciar a los derechos de traducción.
why_this_chunk: editorial (noun, f.) = publisher; the cuya clause is nonrestrictive, so commas.
suggested_ok_english_hint: editoriales: newspaper pieces or companies? Is the cuya clause essential?
english_key: The writer, whose novel had been rejected by several publishers, finally managed to publish it without giving up the translation rights.
acceptables: The writer, whose novel had been rejected by several publishing houses, eventually managed to publish it without relinquishing the translation rights.
The author, whose novel had been turned down by several publishers, finally succeeded in publishing it without waiving the translation rights.

traps.comment: editoriales (las editoriales) = publishers / publishing houses. 'Editorials' are opinion articles.
traps.label: editorial rendered as 'by several editorials'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The writer is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).
traps.label: nonrestrictive commas missing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: Si la empresa hubiera mantenido los registros que estaba obligada a conservar, hoy podría demostrar cómo se utilizaron los fondos recibidos.
why_this_chunk: If + past perfect, then would / could + base verb for a present result; keep hoy (now).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Mixed conditional: the past condition has a present result (hoy podría). Which tense goes in each half?
english_key: If the company had kept the records it was required to retain, it would now be able to show how the funds it received were used.
acceptables: If the company had kept the records that it was obliged to keep, it could now demonstrate how the funds received were used.
Had the company maintained the records it was required to keep, it would today be able to show how the funds it had received were used.

detector.pattern: \bwould have been able to (show|demonstrate|prove)\b|\bif the company would have\b

traps.comment: hoy podría = would now be able (present result). 'Would have been able' moves the result into the past.
traps.label: present result made past
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: hoy = now / today. It marks the present result; dropping it blurs the time contrast.
traps.label: hoy omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La mayoría de los vecinos considera que el ruido ha disminuido, pero un número considerable de familias sigue quejándose durante las noches.
errors_to_catch: singular verb with a number of / most
why_this_chunk: Most residents → plural verb; 'a number of' + plural noun takes a plural verb in US English; vecinos = residents.
suggested_ok_english_hint: La mayoría… considera: singular in Spanish, but what does English do? Same question for 'un número de familias'.
english_key: Most residents believe that the noise has decreased, but a considerable number of families are still complaining at night.
acceptables: Most of the residents think that the noise has decreased, but a considerable number of families continue to complain at night.
The majority of residents consider the noise to have decreased, but a significant number of families are still complaining at night.

detector.pattern: \bnumber of families is\b|\b(majority|most) of (the )?residents considers\b|\bmost residents (believes|considers|thinks)\b

traps.comment: US English: 'a number of families are' and 'most residents believe' take plural verbs.
traps.label: singular verb with a number of / most
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: vecinos in a civic context = residents. 'Neighbors' reads as the people next door.
traps.label: vecinos rendered as neighbors
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Por un lado, la digitalización facilita la consulta de archivos antiguos; por otro, plantea dificultades para quienes no tienen acceso estable a internet.
focus: Por un lado = On the one hand
errors_to_catch: On one side… on the other side
why_this_chunk: Keep the semicolon before on the other; the idiom is On the one hand… on the other (hand).
suggested_ok_english_hint: The semicolon joins two independent clauses. What happens if it becomes a comma?
english_key: On the one hand, digitization makes it easier to consult old archives; on the other, it poses difficulties for those who do not have stable internet access.
acceptables: On the one hand, digitalization facilitates access to old records; on the other hand, it creates difficulties for people without stable access to the internet.
On the one hand, digitization makes it easier to consult old files; on the other hand, it poses difficulties for those who lack stable internet access.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

detector.pattern: \bon (one|the one) side\b|\bon the other side\b|^\s*by one (side|hand)\b

traps.comment: Por un lado… por otro = On the one hand… on the other (hand).
traps.pitfall: Por un lado = On the one hand
traps.label: On one side… on the other side
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: archivos antiguos = old / historical archives. 'Antique' refers to collectible objects.
traps.label: antiguo rendered as 'antique archives'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No había pruebas de que el empleado hubiera alterado los datos, ni tampoco de que hubiera tenido acceso al sistema después de su suspensión.
why_this_chunk: No había pruebas de que + pluperfect subjunctive = no evidence that X had…; pruebas = evidence (mass noun).
suggested_ok_english_hint: hubiera alterado after a past negative: does English need would have?
english_key: There was no evidence that the employee had altered the data, nor that he had had access to the system after his suspension.
acceptables: There was no evidence that the employee had tampered with the data or that he had accessed the system after his suspension.
There was no proof that the employee had altered the data, nor any evidence that he had had access to the system after being suspended.

traps.comment: pruebas = evidence / proof (uncountable in English). 'Proofs' is a count noun used in printing and math.
traps.label: pruebas rendered as 'no proofs'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera + participle) after a past verb of saying, knowing, or doubting is a plain past perfect in English (had + participle), not would have.
traps.label: would have for had
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

spanish_text: Al llegar a la estación, los pasajeros encontraron una nota en la que se les informaba de que el último tren ya había partido.
why_this_chunk: Al + infinitive = When/Upon + -ing, with the passengers as subject; informar de que = inform that.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Al llegar: who arrived? Make sure the English subject is the passengers.
english_key: When they arrived at the station, the passengers found a note informing them that the last train had already left.
acceptables: Upon arriving at the station, the passengers found a note informing them that the last train had already departed.
On arriving at the station, passengers found a note stating that the last train had already left.

traps.comment: Al llegar refers to the passengers. 'Arriving at the station, a note was found' makes the note arrive.
traps.ok: When they arrived at the station, the passengers found a note
traps.no: Upon arriving at the station, a note was found
traps.label: dangling al + infinitive
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Dangling modifiers, p. 25

traps.comment: informar de que = inform (someone) that. 'Of that' is a calque.
traps.label: informar de que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: partir (a train) = leave / depart. 'Parted' means separated.
traps.label: partir rendered as 'had already parted'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Ni la edad de los participantes ni su nivel de estudios explicaban por sí solos las diferencias observadas en los resultados de la encuesta.
errors_to_catch: nivel de estudios rendered as 'level of studies'
why_this_chunk: Neither… nor; por sí solos = alone / by itself; nivel de estudios = level of education.
suggested_ok_english_hint: ni… ni… por sí solos: which pair, and where does 'alone' go?
english_key: Neither the participants' age nor their educational level alone explained the differences observed in the survey results.
acceptables: Neither the age of the participants nor their level of education by itself explained the differences observed in the results of the survey.
Neither the participants' age nor their level of schooling alone accounted for the differences observed in the survey results.

traps.comment: ni… ni = neither… nor. 'Neither… or' is a nonparallel pair.
traps.label: neither paired with or
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: nivel de estudios = educational level / level of education. 'Level of studies' is a calque.
traps.label: nivel de estudios rendered as 'level of studies'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: por sí solos = alone / by themselves. Without it the sentence claims they explained nothing, not that neither was sufficient.
traps.label: por sí solos omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Tanto si la biblioteca abre los domingos como si mantiene su horario actual, será necesario contratar personal para atender la nueva sala de lectura.
errors_to_catch: atender rendered as 'to attend the new reading room'
why_this_chunk: Tanto si… como si = Whether… or; atender = serve / staff; personal = staff.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Tanto si… como si: which English pair expresses 'either way'?
english_key: Whether the library opens on Sundays or keeps its current hours, it will be necessary to hire staff for the new reading room.
acceptables: Whether the library opens on Sundays or maintains its current schedule, it will be necessary to hire personnel to staff the new reading room.
Whether the library opens on Sundays or keeps its current opening hours, staff will have to be hired to serve the new reading room.

detector.pattern: ^\s*(both if|as much if|so much if|if both)\b

traps.comment: Tanto si… como si = Whether… or. 'Both if… as if' is a calque.
traps.label: tanto si… como si calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: atender una sala = serve / staff / run a room. 'Attend' means be present at.
traps.no: to attend the new reading room
traps.label: atender rendered as 'to attend the new reading room'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: personal (noun) = staff / personnel. 'Personal' is an adjective in English.
traps.label: personal rendered as 'hire personal'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El informe distingue los gastos directamente relacionados con la investigación de aquellos que corresponden al funcionamiento habitual de la institución.
why_this_chunk: distinguish X from Y; investigación (academic) = research; habitual = normal / regular.
suggested_ok_english_hint: distinguir X de Y: which preposition does English use? Is investigación research or investigation here?
english_key: The report distinguishes expenses directly related to the research from those that correspond to the institution's normal operations.
acceptables: The report distinguishes expenses directly related to the research from those corresponding to the regular operation of the institution.
The report differentiates between expenditures directly related to the research and those attributable to the institution's ordinary operations.

traps.comment: distinguir X de Y = distinguish X from Y (or between X and Y). 'Of' is a calque of de.
traps.label: distinguish… from
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: investigación in a funding report = research. 'Investigation' suggests an inquiry into wrongdoing.
traps.label: investigación rendered as 'the investigation'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: funcionamiento habitual = normal / regular operations. 'Habitual' is for personal habits.
traps.label: habitual rendered as 'habitual functioning'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Cuanto más se retrasaba la apertura del mercado, menos vendedores estaban dispuestos a reservar un puesto y más difícil resultaba financiar las instalaciones.
why_this_chunk: The longer…, the fewer… and the more difficult…; instalaciones = facilities.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuanto más… menos… más: three parallel 'the -er' parts. Vendors are countable: fewer or less?
english_key: The longer the opening of the market was delayed, the fewer vendors were willing to reserve a stall and the more difficult it became to finance the facilities.
acceptables: The more the market's opening was delayed, the fewer vendors were willing to book a stall and the harder it became to finance the facilities.
The longer the market's opening was delayed, the fewer vendors were prepared to reserve a booth and the harder it became to fund the facilities.

traps.comment: vendedores is countable: the fewer vendors, not the less vendors.
traps.label: less with a count noun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: Cuanto más… = The longer / The more…. 'As much as' is a calque and breaks the correlative.
traps.label: cuanto más calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: instalaciones (of a market) = facilities. 'Installations' are fitted equipment or art works.
traps.label: instalaciones rendered as 'the installations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: En ningún momento se informó a la familia de que la autorización podía retirarse si cambiaban las condiciones que habían permitido concederla.
errors_to_catch: no inversion after At no time
en ningún momento rendered as 'At no moment'
why_this_chunk: A fronted negative (At no time) triggers inversion: At no time was the family informed…
suggested_ok_english_hint: En ningún momento at the front: what must English do to the verb?
english_key: At no time was the family informed that the authorization could be withdrawn if the conditions that had allowed it to be granted changed.
acceptables: At no point was the family told that the authorization could be revoked if the conditions that had made it possible to grant it changed.
The family was never informed that the permit could be withdrawn if the conditions that had allowed it to be granted were to change.

traps.comment: A fronted negative adverbial requires subject–auxiliary inversion: At no time was the family….
traps.ok: At no time was the family
traps.no: At no time the family was
traps.label: no inversion after At no time
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: En ningún momento = At no time / At no point / never. 'At no moment' is a calque.
traps.label: en ningún momento rendered as 'At no moment'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Los resultados obtenidos hasta la fecha son prometedores, aunque todavía no permiten determinar si el tratamiento funciona igual en todos los grupos de edad.
why_this_chunk: hasta la fecha = to date / so far; permitir + inf. needs an object or 'make it possible to'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: hasta la fecha / no permiten determinar: two stock phrases. Can English 'allow to determine' stand without an object?
english_key: The results obtained to date are promising, although they do not yet make it possible to determine whether the treatment works equally well in all age groups.
acceptables: The results obtained so far are promising, although they do not yet allow researchers to determine whether the treatment works the same way in all age groups.
The results obtained thus far are promising, although they still do not show whether the treatment is equally effective across all age groups.

traps.comment: hasta la fecha = to date / so far. 'Until the date' is a calque.
traps.label: hasta la fecha calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La directora pidió que se conservaran los mensajes originales, se identificara a sus destinatarios y no se difundieran copias mientras avanzara la investigación.
why_this_chunk: Mandative subjunctive (be preserved / be identified / be distributed); difundir = distribute / circulate.
suggested_ok_english_hint: pidió que + three subjunctives: what is the US form after 'asked that'?
english_key: The director asked that the original messages be preserved, that their recipients be identified, and that no copies be distributed while the investigation was ongoing.
acceptables: The director requested that the original messages be kept, their recipients identified, and no copies circulated while the investigation proceeded.
The director asked that the original messages be retained, that their recipients be identified, and that no copies be disseminated while the investigation was in progress.

traps.comment: After ask that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after ask that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: difundir copias = distribute / circulate / disseminate. 'Diffuse' is for light, gas, or tension.
traps.label: difundir rendered as 'be diffused'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Si bien la ruta es más corta, recorrerla de noche puede llevar más tiempo debido a las restricciones que se aplican a los vehículos pesados.
errors_to_catch: si bien rendered as if / even if
why_this_chunk: Si bien = Although / While (concession of fact). US spelling: traveling.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si bien: a fact or a hypothesis?
english_key: Although the route is shorter, traveling it at night can take longer because of the restrictions that apply to heavy vehicles.
acceptables: While the route is shorter, driving it at night may take more time due to the restrictions applied to heavy vehicles.
Although the route is shorter, covering it at night can take longer because of the restrictions imposed on heavy vehicles.

traps.comment: si bien = although / while (a concession of fact). 'Even if' or 'if' turns a fact into a hypothesis.
traps.label: si bien rendered as if / even if
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: US target: traveling, not travelling.
traps.label: travelling (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: En cuanto termine la temporada de lluvias, los arqueólogos regresarán al lugar donde se encontraron los fragmentos de cerámica.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: En cuanto + subjunctive = As soon as + present tense.
suggested_ok_english_hint: En cuanto termine: what does en cuanto mean, and does English put will after 'as soon as'?
english_key: As soon as the rainy season ends, the archaeologists will return to the site where the pottery fragments were found.
acceptables: Once the rainy season is over, the archaeologists will return to the site where the ceramic fragments were found.
As soon as the rainy season ends, archaeologists will go back to the place where the pottery shards were found.

traps.comment: En cuanto + verb = As soon as / Once. 'In as much as' means because.
traps.label: en cuanto = as soon as
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: \b(as soon as|once|when) the rainy season (will end|will be over|will finish)\b

traps.comment: en cuanto + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: El acuerdo no obliga a los agricultores a vender toda su producción, sino únicamente la cantidad que se hayan comprometido a entregar.
why_this_chunk: sino únicamente = but only; obligar a alguien a = require / oblige someone to.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no… sino únicamente: what limits the obligation?
english_key: The agreement does not require farmers to sell all of their production, but only the quantity they have committed to deliver.
acceptables: The agreement does not oblige farmers to sell their entire output, only the amount they have committed to deliver.
The agreement does not require farmers to sell all of their production but only the quantity that they have agreed to deliver.

traps.comment: únicamente limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: únicamente omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: obligar a alguien a hacer = require / oblige someone to do. The personal a is not 'to'.
traps.label: personal a calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: sino after a negative = but. 'If not' (si no) changes the meaning.
traps.label: sino rendered as if not
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: No basta con que un dato sea correcto; también debe presentarse de manera que el lector pueda interpretar su alcance sin recurrir a explicaciones adicionales.
focus: un dato = a piece of data
why_this_chunk: Keep the semicolon; un dato = a piece of data / a figure / a data point; alcance = scope.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Two independent clauses around a semicolon. And can 'data' take 'a'?
english_key: It is not enough for a piece of data to be correct; it must also be presented in such a way that the reader can interpret its scope without resorting to additional explanations.
acceptables: It is not enough for a figure to be correct; it must also be presented so that readers can interpret its scope without needing additional explanations.
It is not sufficient for a data point to be accurate; it must also be presented in a way that lets the reader understand its scope without relying on further explanations.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: un dato = a piece of data / a figure / a data point. 'A data' is ungrammatical.
traps.pitfall: un dato = a piece of data
traps.label: a data
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: alcance (of a figure) = scope / significance. 'Reach' is physical or audience reach.
traps.label: alcance rendered as 'its reach'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La cifra anunciada por el alcalde, que inicialmente parecía confirmar una mejora, incluía pagos correspondientes al ejercicio anterior.
why_this_chunk: ejercicio (fiscal) = fiscal year; cifra = figure; the que clause is nonrestrictive.
suggested_ok_english_hint: ejercicio in public finance, and cifra: what are they in English?

The figure that the mayor announced, which initially seemed to confirm an improvement, included payments from the prior fiscal year.

traps.comment: ejercicio (fiscal / presupuestario) = fiscal year. 'Exercise' is physical activity or a drill.

traps.comment: cifra = figure / number. 'Cipher' is a code.
traps.label: cifra rendered as 'The cipher'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The figure is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).

traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: A falta de una explicación convincente, los clientes empezaron a sospechar que el cierre temporal de la sucursal se prolongaría más de lo previsto.
why_this_chunk: A falta de = In the absence of / Lacking; se prolongaría = would last (past-future).
suggested_ok_english_hint: A falta de… / más de lo previsto: two set phrases. And empezaron a sospechar is past: what tense follows?
english_key: In the absence of a convincing explanation, customers began to suspect that the temporary closure of the branch would last longer than expected.
acceptables: Lacking a convincing explanation, customers began to suspect that the branch's temporary closure would go on longer than planned.
In the absence of a convincing explanation, the customers began to suspect that the temporary closure of the branch would last longer than planned.

traps.comment: A falta de = In the absence of / Lacking / For lack of. 'At the lack of' is a calque.
traps.label: a falta de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: \bclos(ure|ing) of the branch will\b|\bbranch's temporary clos(ure|ing) will\b

traps.comment: After a past verb (began to suspect), se prolongaría = would last. 'Will' breaks the sequence of tenses.

traps.comment: más de lo previsto = longer than expected / planned. 'Than foreseen' is a calque.
