traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: El profesor señaló que algunos alumnos habían entendido la consigna, pero que otros confundían la fecha de entrega con la de publicación de los resultados.
why_this_chunk: consigna = instructions / assignment; fecha de entrega = due date; señalar = note / point out.
suggested_ok_english_hint: consigna and fecha de entrega in a classroom: what are they?
english_key: The teacher noted that some students had understood the instructions, but that others were confusing the due date with the publication date for the results.
acceptables: The professor pointed out that some students had understood the assignment but that others were confusing the submission deadline with the date when the results would be published.
The teacher noted that some of the students had understood the instructions, but that others confused the due date with the date of publication of the results.

traps.comment: consigna (class) = instructions / assignment. 'Slogan' is the political sense.
traps.label: consigna rendered as 'the slogan'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: señalar que = note / point out that. 'Signaled' means gave a signal.
traps.label: señalar rendered as 'signaled'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: fecha de entrega (homework) = due date / submission deadline. 'Delivery date' is for goods.
traps.label: entrega rendered as 'delivery date'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: De los cinco puentes inspeccionados, solo dos reunían las condiciones necesarias para permitir el paso inmediato de vehículos de carga.
why_this_chunk: solo = only; reunir las condiciones = meet the conditions / requirements.
suggested_ok_english_hint: solo dos: is the restriction still there? And reunir condiciones means…?
english_key: Of the five bridges inspected, only two met the necessary conditions to allow freight vehicles to cross immediately.
acceptables: Of the five bridges that were inspected, only two met the conditions required to allow cargo vehicles to cross immediately.
Of the five bridges inspected, only two met the conditions needed for the immediate passage of freight vehicles.

traps.comment: solo limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solo omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: reunir condiciones / requisitos = meet conditions / requirements. 'Gather' or 'reunite' is a calque.

traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Lejos de reducir la carga de trabajo, el nuevo formulario obligó a los usuarios a presentar documentos que ya figuraban en otros registros.
why_this_chunk: Lejos de = Far from + -ing; figurar = appear / be listed; formulario = form.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Lejos de… / figurar / formulario: three easy calques.
english_key: Far from reducing the workload, the new form forced users to submit documents that already appeared in other records.
acceptables: Far from reducing the workload, the new form required users to submit documents that were already on file in other registries.
Far from easing the workload, the new form obliged users to provide documents that already appeared in other records.

traps.comment: Lejos de + inf. = Far from + -ing. 'Far of' is a calque.
traps.label: lejos de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: figurar (en un registro) = appear / be listed / be on file. 'Figured' means calculated or thought.
traps.label: figurar rendered as 'already figured'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: formulario = form. A formulary is a list of medicines.
traps.label: formulario rendered as 'the new formulary'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A menos que aparezcan nuevas pruebas, el tribunal no volverá a examinar los hechos que las partes aceptaron como ciertos durante la audiencia.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: audiencia = hearing; pruebas = evidence; A menos que + subjunctive = Unless + present.
suggested_ok_english_hint: audiencia in court, and pruebas: count or mass noun? What tense follows 'unless'?
english_key: Unless new evidence comes to light, the court will not reexamine the facts that the parties accepted as true during the hearing.
acceptables: Unless new evidence emerges, the court will not examine again the facts that the parties accepted as true at the hearing.
Unless new evidence appears, the court will not re-examine the facts that the parties accepted as true during the hearing.

traps.comment: audiencia (judicial) = hearing. 'Audience' is the people watching.
traps.label: audiencia rendered as 'the audience'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: a menos que + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.no: new evidence will come to light
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: pruebas = evidence (uncountable). 'Proofs' is for printing and math.
traps.label: pruebas rendered as 'new proofs'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El equipo necesitaba menos tiempo para clasificar las muestras que para comprobar si las etiquetas correspondían al lugar de origen.
why_this_chunk: less… than (not that); comprobar = check / verify.
suggested_ok_english_hint: menos tiempo para X que para Y: which comparative word follows less?
english_key: The team needed less time to classify the samples than to check whether the labels matched the place of origin.
acceptables: The team needed less time to sort the samples than to verify whether the labels corresponded to the place of origin.
It took the team less time to classify the samples than to check whether the labels matched their place of origin.

traps.comment: menos… que = less… than. 'That' is a calque of que.
traps.label: less… that
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: comprobar si = check / verify whether. 'Prove whether' asserts a demonstration.
traps.label: comprobar rendered as 'to prove whether'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Fue precisamente cuando los organizadores creían haber resuelto los problemas de acceso cuando comenzaron a llegar quejas por la falta de asientos.
why_this_chunk: It was precisely when… that…; creían haber resuelto = believed they had solved (same subject).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Fue precisamente cuando… cuando: how does the English it-cleft close?
english_key: It was precisely when the organizers believed they had solved the access problems that complaints began to arrive about the lack of seating.
acceptables: It was just when the organizers thought they had resolved the access problems that complaints started coming in about the lack of seats.
Precisely when the organizers believed they had solved the problems with access, complaints began to arrive about the shortage of seating.

traps.comment: The Spanish cleft repeats cuando; the English it-cleft closes with that: It was precisely when… that….
traps.label: cleft closed with when
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: creían haber resuelto = believed they had solved. 'Believed to have solved' means other people believed it of them.
traps.label: believed to have…
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: A fin de que las instrucciones resulten comprensibles, se sustituirán las abreviaturas poco conocidas por sus denominaciones completas.
errors_to_catch: sustituir… por rendered as substituted by
why_this_chunk: sustituir X por Y = replace X with Y (substitute Y for X); compound adjective before a noun takes a hyphen.
suggested_ok_english_hint: sustituir X por Y: which way round does English 'substitute' go?
english_key: So that the instructions are easy to understand, little-known abbreviations will be replaced with their full names.
acceptables: In order for the instructions to be understandable, little-known abbreviations will be replaced by their full forms.
So that the instructions are understandable, abbreviations that are not well known will be replaced with their full names.

traps.comment: sustituir X por Y = replace X with Y. 'Substitute X by/for Y' reverses or garbles the direction.
traps.label: sustituir… por rendered as substituted by
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: A compound modifier before a noun is hyphenated: little-known abbreviations.
traps.label: compound modifier not hyphenated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Hyphens, p. 28

traps.comment: denominaciones completas = full names / full forms. 'Denominations' are religious groups or currency units.
traps.label: denominación rendered as 'full denominations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La empresa no aclaró si el descuento se aplicaría a todos los compradores o solamente a quienes hubieran realizado una reserva previa.
why_this_chunk: solamente = only; reserva previa = advance / prior reservation.
suggested_ok_english_hint: solamente a quienes: keep the restriction. What is a reserva previa?
english_key: The company did not clarify whether the discount would apply to all buyers or only to those who had made an advance reservation.
acceptables: The company did not make clear whether the discount would be applied to all buyers or only to those who had booked in advance.
The company did not clarify whether the discount would apply to all purchasers or solely to those who had made a prior reservation.

traps.comment: solamente limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solamente omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: reserva previa = advance / prior reservation. 'Previous reservation' means an earlier, different booking.
traps.label: previo rendered as 'a previous reservation'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Mientras unos investigadores consideran que la disminución es pasajera, otros advierten que podría indicar un cambio de mayor alcance.
why_this_chunk: advertir = warn / caution; pasajera = temporary; de mayor alcance = more far-reaching.
suggested_ok_english_hint: advierten: warn or advise? And pasajera?

acceptables: Whereas some researchers consider the decrease to be temporary, others caution that it might signal a broader change.
While some researchers think the decline is temporary, others warn that it could point to a more significant change.

traps.comment: advertir que = warn / caution that. 'Advise' means recommend.
traps.label: advertir rendered as 'others advise'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: pasajero (adj.) = temporary / transient. 'Passenger' is a traveler.
traps.label: pasajero rendered as 'is passing'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Compound modifier before a noun: far-reaching.

traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Hyphens, p. 28

spanish_text: Los vecinos, muchos de los cuales llevaban décadas en el barrio, rechazaron la propuesta de trasladar el mercado a las afueras.
why_this_chunk: many of whom (people, object of of); llevar + time = have been / have lived for; US spelling neighborhood.
suggested_ok_english_hint: muchos de los cuales (people): which relative? And llevaban décadas means…?
english_key: The residents, many of whom had lived in the neighborhood for decades, rejected the proposal to move the market to the outskirts.
acceptables: The residents, many of whom had been living in the neighborhood for decades, rejected the proposal to relocate the market to the outskirts.
The local residents, many of whom had lived in the area for decades, rejected the proposal to move the market to the outskirts of town.

traps.comment: US target: neighborhood, not neighbourhood.

traps.comment: The relative pronoun is the object of its clause, so formal English uses whom.
traps.label: who for whom
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Who and whom, p. 64

traps.label: llevar + time calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Una cosa es reconocer que hubo errores de planificación y otra muy distinta afirmar que todas las inversiones carecieron de utilidad.

suggested_ok_english_hint: Una cosa es… y otra muy distinta: English has a ready-made frame.

acceptables: Acknowledging that there were planning mistakes is one thing; claiming that none of the investments served any purpose is quite another.
It is one thing to recognize that there were errors in planning and quite another to assert that all of the investments lacked any value.

traps.comment: Una cosa es X y otra Y = It is one thing to X and quite another to Y. 'One thing is to…' is a calque.

spanish_text: Si no fuera por el apoyo de los voluntarios, el archivo permanecería cerrado al público durante buena parte del año.
errors_to_catch: was for were in an unreal condition
why_this_chunk: If it were not for… / Were it not for…, … would remain; buena parte = much / a good part (not most).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si no fuera por: unreal present. Which verb form after if, and which in the result?

acceptables: Were it not for the support of the volunteers, the archive would stay closed to the public for a good part of the year.
Without the support of volunteers, the archive would remain closed to the public for a large part of the year.

traps.comment: Si no fuera por = If it were not for / Were it not for. Formal US English keeps the subjunctive were in unreal conditions.
traps.label: was for were in an unreal condition

traps.comment: Unreal condition: the result clause takes would, not will.
traps.label: will in an unreal condition

traps.comment: buena parte = much / a good part. 'Most' overstates the source.

spanish_text: El documento fue firmado por tres representantes, ninguno de los cuales estaba facultado para modificar las condiciones económicas del convenio.
errors_to_catch: comma missing before none of whom
why_this_chunk: none of whom (people), set off by a comma; condiciones económicas = financial terms.
suggested_ok_english_hint: ninguno de los cuales (people): which relative? Comma or no comma?

acceptables: The document was signed by three representatives, none of whom were authorized to change the financial terms of the agreement.
The document was signed by three representatives, none of whom had the authority to amend the financial conditions of the agreement.

traps.comment: The relative pronoun is the object of its clause, so formal English uses whom.
traps.label: who for whom
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Who and whom, p. 64

traps.comment: none of whom… is a nonrestrictive relative clause; it needs a comma.
traps.label: comma missing before none of whom
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: condiciones económicas (de un convenio) = financial terms. 'Economic conditions' means the state of the economy.
traps.label: condiciones económicas rendered as 'economic conditions'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No obstante lo acordado inicialmente, las partes decidieron aplazar la entrega hasta que el proveedor pudiera demostrar que el equipo funcionaba correctamente.
why_this_chunk: No obstante + noun phrase = Notwithstanding / Despite; el equipo (device) = the equipment.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No obstante lo acordado: is No obstante a connector here or a preposition?

acceptables: Despite the initial agreement, the parties decided to postpone the delivery until the supplier was able to show that the equipment worked correctly.

traps.comment: No obstante + noun phrase is a preposition = Notwithstanding / Despite. 'Nevertheless what was agreed' is ungrammatical.

traps.comment: hasta que + past subjunctive = until X could / was able to. 'Until X would' is a calque.
traps.no: until the supplier would be able to

traps.comment: el equipo (machine) = the equipment. 'The team' is a group of people.

traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Por más que se repitan las mediciones, sus resultados no serán comparables si se emplean instrumentos calibrados con criterios diferentes.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: Por más que = No matter how (much / often); if + present tense; criteria is plural.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por más que + subjunctive: a concession. And what tense follows 'if'?

traps.comment: Por más que = No matter how much / However often. 'For more that' is a calque.
traps.label: por más que calqued

traps.comment: si (condition) + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses

traps.comment: criteria is already plural (singular criterion).

traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: Antes de establecer nuevas sanciones, los legisladores deberán examinar si las existentes se aplican y qué resultados han producido.
why_this_chunk: Supply 'they' and 'ones'; existentes = existing.
suggested_ok_english_hint: qué resultados han producido: English needs a subject. And existentes?

acceptables: Before introducing new penalties, legislators will have to examine whether the existing ones are enforced and what results they have produced.
Before imposing new sanctions, lawmakers will need to examine whether the current ones are being applied and what results they have yielded.

traps.comment: qué resultados han producido: English needs an explicit subject (what results they have produced).
traps.label: missing subject
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: existentes = existing. 'Existent' is a philosophical term.
traps.label: existente rendered as 'the existent ones'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: las existentes: English needs 'ones' after an adjective used as a noun.
traps.label: adjective used as noun
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Ni siquiera una reducción importante del precio garantizaría que las familias de menores ingresos pudieran acceder a las viviendas ofrecidas.

acceptables: Not even a significant reduction in price would guarantee that low-income families could gain access to the homes offered.

traps.comment: Ni siquiera… garantizaría: English 'Not even…' already negates; adding 'would not' makes a double negative.

traps.comment: importante (amount) = significant / major. 'Important' means having consequence.
traps.label: importante rendered as 'important price reduction'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Compound modifier before a noun: lower-income families.
traps.label: lower income without hyphen
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Hyphens, p. 28

spanish_text: La asociación propuso organizar talleres, facilitar materiales gratuitos y crear espacios en los que los participantes pudieran compartir sus experiencias.
why_this_chunk: facilitar = provide / supply; three parallel -ing (or three parallel to-) forms.
suggested_ok_english_hint: facilitar materiales: what does facilitar mean here? Keep the three verbs in the same form.

traps.comment: A series after proposed must keep one form: organizing…, providing…, and creating….

traps.comment: gratuito = free (of charge). 'Gratuitous' means unjustified.

traps.comment: opted to change… and extend…: keep both verbs as bare infinitives.
traps.label: mixed infinitive and -ing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: La propuesta parecía razonable a primera vista; sin embargo, no especificaba quién asumiría el mantenimiento de los equipos después de su instalación.
why_this_chunk: Semicolon before however and a comma after it; equipos = equipment (uncountable).
suggested_ok_english_hint: ; sin embargo, — what punctuation does however need between two clauses?
english_key: The proposal seemed reasonable at first glance; however, it did not specify who would be responsible for maintaining the equipment after installation.
acceptables: At first sight, the proposal seemed reasonable; however, it did not specify who would take on the maintenance of the equipment once it was installed.
The proposal appeared reasonable at first glance; however, it did not state who would assume responsibility for maintaining the equipment after its installation.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: A conjunctive adverb opening a clause takes a comma: however, it….
traps.label: no comma after however
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Commas: Conjunctive adverbs, p. 18

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Tal como se había advertido en la evaluación inicial, algunas viviendas presentaban daños que no podían repararse sin desalojar temporalmente a sus ocupantes.
why_this_chunk: advertir = warn; presentar daños = have / show damage (mass noun); desalojar temporalmente = temporarily evacuate / relocate.
suggested_ok_english_hint: advertir: warn or advise? And presentaban daños?
english_key: As the initial assessment had warned, some homes had damage that could not be repaired without temporarily evacuating their occupants.
acceptables: As the initial assessment had cautioned, some homes showed damage that could not be repaired without temporarily relocating their occupants.
As warned in the initial assessment, some houses had damage that could not be repaired without temporarily moving their occupants out.

traps.comment: advertir = warn / caution. 'Advise' means recommend; the warning disappears.
traps.label: advertir rendered as advise
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: daños (physical) = damage, uncountable. 'Damages' is money awarded by a court.
traps.label: daños rendered as 'presented damages'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: desalojar temporalmente for repairs = evacuate / relocate. 'Evict' implies a legal removal.
traps.label: desalojar rendered as 'evicting'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Cuando los técnicos llegaron al laboratorio, descubrieron que la temperatura había aumentado desde la noche anterior y que varias muestras se habían deteriorado.
errors_to_catch: simple past / present perfect with since
why_this_chunk: arrive at (a building); had risen since (past perfect); técnicos = technicians.
suggested_ok_english_hint: había aumentado desde: which English tense with 'since' in a past narrative?
english_key: When the technicians arrived at the laboratory, they discovered that the temperature had risen since the night before and that several samples had deteriorated.
acceptables: When the technicians got to the laboratory, they found that the temperature had increased since the previous night and that several samples had deteriorated.
When the technicians arrived at the lab, they discovered that the temperature had gone up since the night before and that several of the samples had spoiled.

traps.comment: llegar a un lugar = arrive at (a building) / in (a city). 'Arrived to' is nonstandard.
traps.label: arrived to
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: había aumentado desde = had risen since. 'Rose since' / 'has risen since' break the past-perfect frame.
traps.label: simple past / present perfect with since
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: técnicos = technicians. 'Technics' is a field of technique.
traps.label: técnico rendered as 'the technics'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La campaña tuvo éxito no tanto por el dinero invertido como por la colaboración de las organizaciones que ya trabajaban con las comunidades.
why_this_chunk: not so much X as Y (as, not but / than).
suggested_ok_english_hint: no tanto por… como por: which word pairs with 'not so much'?
english_key: The campaign succeeded not so much because of the money invested as because of the cooperation of organizations that were already working with the communities.
acceptables: The campaign was successful not so much because of the money invested as because of the collaboration of organizations already working with the communities.
The campaign's success was due not so much to the money invested as to the cooperation of the organizations that were already working with the communities.

traps.comment: no tanto… como = not so much… as. 'Not so much… but' is nonparallel.
traps.label: not so much… but
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: tuvo éxito = succeeded / was successful. 'Had success' is a calque.
traps.label: tener éxito calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Dado que nadie había confirmado la recepción de la carta, el abogado aconsejó enviarla nuevamente por un medio que permitiera acreditar su entrega.
why_this_chunk: acreditar = prove / provide proof of; advise + -ing (or advise someone to).
suggested_ok_english_hint: acreditar su entrega: accredit? And what follows 'advised' when there is no object?
english_key: Since no one had confirmed receipt of the letter, the lawyer advised sending it again by a method that would provide proof of delivery.
acceptables: Because nobody had acknowledged receipt of the letter, the attorney recommended resending it by a means that would make it possible to prove its delivery.
Since no one had confirmed receiving the letter, the lawyer advised sending it again using a method that would allow its delivery to be proven.

traps.comment: acreditar la entrega = prove / provide proof of delivery. 'Accredit' means officially recognize.
traps.label: acreditar rendered as 'accredit its delivery'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: aconsejar + inf. with no stated person = advise / recommend + -ing. 'Advised to send' needs an object (advised the client to send).
traps.label: advised to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: medio (de envío) = method / means. 'Medium' is a channel of communication or art.
traps.label: medio rendered as 'by a medium'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El encargado afirmó que las puertas se habían cerrado a las seis, aunque varios testigos aseguraron haber entrado después de esa hora.
errors_to_catch: asegurar rendered as 'assured to have entered'
why_this_chunk: asegurar = claim / insist (not assure, which means reassure); keep a US time format.
suggested_ok_english_hint: asegurar haber entrado: assure or claim? And how does US English write the hour?
english_key: The manager stated that the doors had been closed at six o'clock, although several witnesses claimed to have entered after that time.
acceptables: The person in charge stated that the doors had been locked at six, although several witnesses said they had gone in after that time.
The manager said that the doors had closed at six, although several witnesses insisted that they had entered after that hour.

traps.comment: asegurar haber hecho algo = claim / insist that one did. 'Assure' means reassure someone.
traps.label: asegurar rendered as 'assured to have entered'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: el encargado = the manager / the person in charge. 'The in charge' is not a noun phrase.
traps.label: encargado rendered as 'The in charge'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: US English does not use the 24-hour clock in general prose: six o'clock / 6:00 p.m.
traps.label: 24-hour clock
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Numbers, p. 37

spanish_text: No solo había disminuido el número de visitantes, sino que también se había reducido el tiempo que pasaban en el centro histórico.
errors_to_catch: no inversion after fronted not only
why_this_chunk: A fronted Not only triggers inversion (Not only had…), completed by but… also; US spelling center.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No solo… sino que también, with no solo up front: what must the English verb do?
english_key: Not only had the number of visitors decreased, but the time they spent in the historic center had also been reduced.
acceptables: Not only had the number of visitors fallen, but the amount of time they spent in the historic district had also decreased.
The number of visitors had not only declined, but the time they spent in the historic center had also shrunk.

traps.comment: Fronted Not only requires inversion: Not only had the number of visitors decreased….
traps.label: no inversion after fronted not only
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: not only… must be completed by but (also). 'And' breaks the pair.
traps.label: not only without but
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: US target: center, not centre.
traps.label: centre (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: Por lo que respecta a los materiales recuperados, todavía no se ha decidido cuáles podrán reutilizarse y cuáles deberán desecharse.
errors_to_catch: por lo que respecta a calqued
why_this_chunk: Por lo que respecta a = As for / With regard to; todavía no = not yet.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por lo que respecta a: a topic marker. And todavía no?
english_key: As for the recovered materials, it has not yet been decided which can be reused and which must be discarded.
acceptables: With regard to the recovered materials, it has not yet been decided which ones can be reused and which ones will have to be discarded.
As regards the salvaged materials, no decision has yet been made on which can be reused and which must be thrown away.

traps.comment: Por lo que respecta a = As for / With regard to. 'For what respects' is a calque.
traps.label: por lo que respecta a calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: todavía no = not yet. Dropping 'yet' turns 'still undecided' into a flat statement.
traps.label: todavía omitted (yet)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Quienquiera que resulte elegido para dirigir el proyecto tendrá que justificar sus decisiones ante un comité integrado por representantes de distintas áreas.
why_this_chunk: resultar elegido = be chosen; integrado por = made up of; use they/their for an unspecified person.
suggested_ok_english_hint: resulte elegido / integrado por: two calques waiting to happen. And the pronoun for an unknown person?
english_key: Whoever is chosen to lead the project will have to justify their decisions to a committee made up of representatives from different areas.
acceptables: Whoever is selected to direct the project will have to justify their decisions before a committee composed of representatives of various areas.
Whoever is elected to head the project will have to justify their decisions to a committee consisting of representatives from different departments.

traps.comment: resultar elegido = be chosen / elected. 'Results chosen' is a calque.
traps.label: resultar + participle calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: integrado por = made up of / composed of. 'Integrated by' is a calque.
traps.label: integrado por rendered as 'integrated by'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Quienquiera que: the person is unknown. Avoid a generic 'his'; use their or recast.
traps.label: generic his
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

spanish_text: La tienda informó a sus clientes de que los productos adquiridos en promoción podrían cambiarse, pero no darían derecho a un reembolso.
why_this_chunk: cambiar (a product) = exchange; informar de que = inform that; en promoción = on sale.
suggested_ok_english_hint: cambiarse in a store: changed or exchanged? And informar de que?
english_key: The store informed its customers that products purchased on sale could be exchanged but would not entitle them to a refund.
acceptables: The store informed its customers that items bought on promotion could be exchanged, but would not give them the right to a refund.
The shop told its customers that products purchased during the promotion could be exchanged but were not eligible for a refund.

traps.comment: cambiar un producto (in a store) = exchange it. 'Changed' means altered.
traps.label: cambiar rendered as 'could be changed'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: informar a alguien de que = inform someone that. 'Of that' is a calque.
traps.label: informar de que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: en promoción = on sale / on promotion. 'In promotion' is a calque.
traps.label: en promoción calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: La decisión de trasladar la exposición, anunciada apenas dos días antes de su inauguración, sorprendió tanto a los artistas como a los patrocinadores.
errors_to_catch: both… as well as / both… as
why_this_chunk: inauguración = opening; tanto… como = both… and; set off the participial phrase with commas.
suggested_ok_english_hint: inauguración of an exhibition, and tanto… como: which English pair?
english_key: The decision to move the exhibition, announced just two days before its opening, surprised both the artists and the sponsors.
acceptables: The decision to relocate the exhibition, which was announced only two days before it opened, surprised both the artists and the sponsors.
The decision to move the exhibit, announced barely two days before the opening, took both the artists and the sponsors by surprise.

traps.comment: inauguración (exhibition) = opening. 'Inauguration' is for officials taking office.
traps.label: inauguración rendered as 'its inauguration'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: tanto… como = both… and. 'Both… as well as' and 'both X as Y' are nonparallel.
traps.label: both… as well as / both… as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: The participial phrase (anunciada…) is parenthetical and needs commas on both sides.
traps.label: parenthetical phrase without commas
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: Hasta que se aclaren las circunstancias del incidente, no será posible determinar si hubo negligencia o si se trató de una falla imprevisible.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: se trató de = it was; Hasta que + subjunctive = Until + present.
suggested_ok_english_hint: se trató de: what is it in English? And what tense after 'until' with future reference?
english_key: Until the circumstances of the incident are clarified, it will not be possible to determine whether there was negligence or whether it was an unforeseeable failure.
acceptables: Until the circumstances surrounding the incident have been clarified, it will not be possible to determine whether there was negligence or an unforeseeable malfunction.
Until the circumstances of the incident are cleared up, it will be impossible to establish whether negligence was involved or whether it was an unpredictable failure.

detector.pattern: \bit treated\b|\bit was treated of\b|\bit dealt with an\b

traps.comment: se trató de = it was / it involved. 'It treated of' is a calque.
traps.label: tratarse de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: hasta que + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: Los propietarios que alquilan sus viviendas por períodos cortos deberán registrarlas, a diferencia de quienes las destinan exclusivamente a uso familiar.
errors_to_catch: commas added to a restrictive clause
why_this_chunk: Restrictive clause (only owners who rent): no commas; a diferencia de = unlike; destinar a = use for.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Is the 'who' clause identifying which owners, or describing all owners?
english_key: Owners who rent out their homes for short periods will have to register them, unlike those who use them exclusively for family purposes.
acceptables: Property owners who rent their homes for short periods must register them, as opposed to those who use them solely for their families.
Owners who rent out their homes on a short-term basis will be required to register them, unlike owners who use them exclusively as family residences.

traps.comment: The clause identifies which owners; it is restrictive, so no comma before who/that.
traps.label: commas added to a restrictive clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: a diferencia de = unlike / as opposed to. 'At difference of' is a calque.
traps.label: a diferencia de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: destinar a = use for / devote to. 'Destine' means predetermine a fate.
traps.label: destinar rendered as 'destine them exclusively'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Algunos testigos recordaban haber oído una alarma; otros, en cambio, afirmaron que no se activó ningún aviso audible.
why_this_chunk: remember + -ing = recall a past event; remember to = not forget. Semicolon (or while) between the clauses.
suggested_ok_english_hint: recordaban haber oído: remember + which verb form? Keep the semicolon or add while.
english_key: Some witnesses remembered hearing an alarm; others, however, stated that no audible warning had gone off.
acceptables: Some witnesses recalled having heard an alarm; others, on the other hand, said that no audible alert had been activated.
Some witnesses remembered hearing an alarm, while others insisted that no audible warning had sounded.

traps.comment: recordar haber oído = remember hearing. 'Remembered to hear' means did not forget to listen.
traps.label: remembered to + verb
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: en cambio = however / on the other hand. 'In exchange' means in return for something.
traps.label: en cambio rendered as 'in exchange'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El nuevo horario beneficia a quienes trabajan por la mañana, pero puede perjudicar a quienes dependen del transporte público después de las diez de la noche.
why_this_chunk: perjudicar = hurt / harm / disadvantage; depend on (not of); 10 p.m. (not 22:00).
suggested_ok_english_hint: perjudicar: prejudice? And how is 'las diez de la noche' written in US English?
english_key: The new schedule benefits those who work in the morning but may hurt those who rely on public transportation after 10 p.m.
acceptables: The new timetable benefits people who work mornings, but it may disadvantage those who depend on public transportation after ten at night.
The new schedule benefits those who work in the morning, but it could harm those who depend on public transit after ten o'clock at night.

traps.comment: perjudicar = harm / hurt / disadvantage. 'Prejudice' means bias.
traps.label: perjudicar rendered as 'prejudice'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: depender de = depend on / rely on. 'Depend of' is a calque.
traps.label: depend of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: US prose uses the 12-hour clock: 10 p.m. / ten at night.
traps.label: 24-hour clock
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Numbers, p. 37

spanish_text: Por más de veinte años, el archivo conservó documentos cuyo valor histórico solo empezó a reconocerse cuando se hizo público su contenido.
errors_to_catch: Por más de + time = For more than
why_this_chunk: cuyo = whose (no extra their); solo empezó = only began.
suggested_ok_english_hint: cuyo valor: which English relative? And keep solo.
english_key: For more than twenty years, the archive preserved documents whose historical value only began to be recognized when their contents were made public.
acceptables: For over twenty years, the archive held documents whose historical value only started to be recognized when their content was made public.
For more than 20 years, the archive preserved documents whose historical value began to be recognized only when their contents were made public.

traps.comment: Por más de veinte años = For more than twenty years (duration). It is not 'por más que' (no matter how).
traps.label: Por más de + time = For more than
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: cuyo = whose. 'Documents which their value…' is a resumptive calque.
traps.label: cuyo rendered as which their
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Relative pronouns, p. 49

traps.comment: solo limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solo omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: No se sabe si la reducción de las emisiones se debe al menor consumo de combustible o a los cambios introducidos en los métodos de medición.
focus: Impersonal se = It is not known
why_this_chunk: Impersonal se = It is not known; menor = lower / reduced (not minor).
suggested_ok_english_hint: No se sabe: who doesn't know? And menor consumo?
english_key: It is not known whether the reduction in emissions is due to lower fuel consumption or to changes introduced in the measurement methods.
acceptables: It is unknown whether the drop in emissions is due to reduced fuel consumption or to changes made to the measurement methods.
It is not known whether the reduction in emissions results from lower fuel consumption or from changes introduced into the measuring methods.

traps.comment: No se sabe = It is not known / It is unknown. 'It does not know' makes 'it' a knower.
traps.pitfall: Impersonal se = It is not known
traps.label: impersonal se calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: menor consumo = lower / reduced consumption. 'Minor' means unimportant.
traps.label: menor rendered as 'minor fuel consumption'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Aunque se habían recibido numerosas solicitudes, la organización no pudo asignar las becas hasta que terminó de verificar los ingresos de los candidatos.
why_this_chunk: asignar becas = award / grant scholarships; hasta que + past = until it had finished.
suggested_ok_english_hint: asignar becas: assign or award? And 'until' + would?
english_key: Although numerous applications had been received, the organization could not award the scholarships until it had finished verifying the candidates' income.
acceptables: Although many applications had been received, the organization was unable to award the scholarships until it finished verifying the applicants' incomes.
Even though numerous applications had been received, the organization could not grant the scholarships until it had completed verification of the candidates' income.

traps.comment: asignar becas = award / grant scholarships. 'Assign' is for tasks or seats.
traps.label: asignar rendered as 'assign the scholarships'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: hasta que terminó = until it had finished / until it finished. 'Until it would' is a calque.
traps.label: until… would
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: ingresos (personal) = income. 'Revenues' is for businesses and governments; 'entries' and 'ingress' are wrong.
traps.label: ingresos rendered as 'candidates' revenues'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Cuanto menos se conozca el origen de una información, mayor será el cuidado que deba tenerse antes de utilizarla para tomar decisiones.
why_this_chunk: The less…, the more…; una información = a piece of information (never 'an information'); tomar decisiones = make decisions (US).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Cuanto menos… mayor: two halves, both starting with 'the'. And una información?
english_key: The less that is known about the source of a piece of information, the more care must be taken before using it to make decisions.
acceptables: The less is known about the origin of information, the greater the care that must be taken before using it to make decisions.
The less that is known about where information comes from, the more careful one must be before using it to make decisions.

traps.comment: Cuanto menos…, mayor… = The less…, the more / the greater…. Both halves need 'the'.
traps.label: second the dropped
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: información is uncountable in English: a piece of information / information.
traps.label: an information
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: tomar decisiones = make decisions in US English. 'Take decisions' is British.
traps.label: take decisions (non-US)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

spanish_text: De manera que nadie quedara excluido, los organizadores ofrecieron traducción simultánea y facilitaron materiales en formatos accesibles.
why_this_chunk: traducción simultánea = simultaneous interpretation; facilitar = provide; De manera que + subjunctive here = So that (purpose).
suggested_ok_english_hint: traducción simultánea is spoken. What do professionals call it? And facilitaron materiales?
english_key: So that no one would be excluded, the organizers offered simultaneous interpretation and provided materials in accessible formats.
acceptables: To ensure that no one was left out, the organizers provided simultaneous interpretation and supplied materials in accessible formats.
So that nobody would be excluded, the organizers offered simultaneous interpreting and made materials available in accessible formats.

traps.comment: traducción simultánea is oral: in English it is simultaneous interpretation. 'Translation' is written.
traps.label: traducción simultánea rendered as 'simultaneous translation'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: facilitar materiales = provide / supply materials. 'Facilitate' means make easier.
traps.label: facilitar rendered as 'facilitated materials'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: ^\s*(in a way that|in such a way that|in a manner that)\b

traps.comment: De manera que + subjunctive (quedara) expresses purpose = So that. 'In a way that' reads as manner.
traps.ok: So that no one would be
traps.no: In a way that no one would be
traps.label: de manera que = so that
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La empresa sostiene que no recibió ninguna advertencia, pero el acta de la inspección indica que su representante firmó una copia del informe.
why_this_chunk: acta = record / minutes; one negative in English (did not receive any / received no); sostener = maintain.
suggested_ok_english_hint: acta de la inspección: act? And no recibió ninguna: how many negatives in English?
english_key: The company maintains that it did not receive any warning, but the inspection record indicates that its representative signed a copy of the report.
acceptables: The company claims that it received no warning, but the inspection record states that its representative signed a copy of the report.
The company insists it was not given any warning, but the minutes of the inspection indicate that its representative signed a copy of the report.

traps.comment: acta (de inspección) = inspection record / report / minutes. An 'act' is a law or a deed.
traps.label: acta rendered as 'the inspection act'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: no recibió ninguna = did not receive any / received no. English allows only one negative.
traps.label: double negative
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: sostener que = maintain / claim that. 'Sustain' means support or suffer.
traps.label: sostener rendered as 'sustains'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No es lo mismo aplazar un pago que quedar exento de realizarlo, distinción que el folleto entregado a los clientes no explicaba con claridad.
why_this_chunk: not the same as (not than / that); entregado = given / handed out.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No es lo mismo… que: which English comparison word?
english_key: Postponing a payment is not the same as being exempted from making it, a distinction that the brochure given to customers did not explain clearly.
acceptables: Deferring a payment is not the same as being exempt from making it, a distinction that the brochure handed out to customers did not clearly explain.
Postponing a payment is not the same thing as being exempted from paying it, a distinction the brochure distributed to clients did not explain clearly.

traps.comment: lo mismo que = the same as. 'The same than' is a calque.
traps.label: the same than
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: folleto entregado = brochure given / handed out. 'Delivered' suggests shipping.
traps.label: entregar rendered as 'brochure delivered'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El parque permanecerá abierto siempre que las condiciones meteorológicas lo permitan y no exista riesgo para los visitantes ni para el personal.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: siempre que = as long as / provided that; condiciones meteorológicas = weather conditions; no… or.
suggested_ok_english_hint: siempre que + subjunctive: condition or frequency? And after 'no risk', or or nor?
english_key: The park will remain open as long as weather conditions permit and there is no risk to visitors or staff.
acceptables: The park will stay open provided that the weather permits and there is no danger to visitors or personnel.
The park will remain open as long as weather conditions allow and there is no risk either to visitors or to staff.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: condiciones meteorológicas = weather conditions. 'Meteorological conditions' is technical jargon.
traps.label: meteorológico rendered as 'meteorological conditions'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: After a negated verb, ni = or. 'Did not X nor Y' is a double negative in US English; use 'or' or 'and did not'.
traps.label: not… nor
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

spanish_text: La publicación, lejos de resolver las dudas sobre la investigación, planteó nuevas preguntas acerca de la procedencia de los datos utilizados.
errors_to_catch: procedencia rendered as 'procedure of the data'
why_this_chunk: procedencia = source / origin / provenance; plantear = raise; investigación may be research or investigation (both accepted).
suggested_ok_english_hint: procedencia: procedure? And plantear preguntas?
english_key: The publication, far from resolving the doubts about the investigation, raised new questions about the source of the data used.
acceptables: The publication, far from dispelling doubts about the research, raised new questions about where the data used had come from.
Far from resolving the doubts about the investigation, the publication raised new questions about the provenance of the data used.

traps.comment: procedencia = source / origin / provenance. 'Procedure' is a method.
traps.label: procedencia rendered as 'procedure of the data'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: plantear preguntas = raise questions. 'Planted' is a calque of the root.
traps.label: plantear rendered as 'planted new questions'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: The interrupting phrase (lejos de…) is set off by commas on both sides.
traps.label: interrupter without commas
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

spanish_text: De haberse consultado a los residentes desde el principio, tal vez se habría elegido un lugar menos expuesto a inundaciones.
errors_to_catch: De haberse calqued as of having
why_this_chunk: De + perfect infinitive = Had… / If… had…; tal vez = might / perhaps; inundaciones = flooding.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De haberse consultado… tal vez se habría: keep the condition and the 'tal vez'.
english_key: Had the residents been consulted from the outset, a site less exposed to flooding might have been chosen.
acceptables: If the residents had been consulted from the beginning, a location less prone to flooding might have been chosen.
Had residents been consulted from the start, perhaps a site less exposed to flooding would have been chosen.

traps.comment: De + perfect infinitive = If… had… / Had…. 'Of having' is a word-for-word calque.
traps.label: De haberse calqued as of having
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: tal vez = perhaps / might. Without it the sentence claims a certainty the source does not.
traps.label: tal vez omitted (certainty added)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: inundaciones = flooding / floods. 'Inundation' is rare and literary.
traps.label: inundación rendered as 'inundations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Las dos propuestas son igualmente viables desde el punto de vista técnico, pero una de ellas requiere el doble de inversión inicial que la otra.
errors_to_catch: inversión rendered as 'initial inversion as the other'
why_this_chunk: el doble de X que = twice as much X as / double the X of; inversión = investment.
suggested_ok_english_hint: el doble de… que: how does English say twice as much… as?
english_key: Both proposals are equally viable from a technical standpoint, but one of them requires twice as much initial investment as the other.
acceptables: The two proposals are equally viable from a technical point of view, but one requires double the initial investment of the other.
Both proposals are equally feasible technically, but one of them requires twice the initial investment that the other does.

traps.comment: inversión (money) = investment. 'Inversion' means turning upside down.
traps.label: inversión rendered as 'initial inversion as the other'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: el doble de… que = twice as much… as / double the…. 'The double of… than' is a calque.
traps.ok: twice as much initial investment as
traps.no: the double of initial investment than
traps.label: el doble de… que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Solo quienes acrediten haber completado la formación podrán solicitar la licencia, independientemente del número de años que lleven ejerciendo la actividad.
why_this_chunk: Solo = Only; formación = training; US spelling license (noun and verb).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Solo quienes: keep the restriction. Formación and licence: what are the US forms?
english_key: Only those who can prove that they have completed the training may apply for the license, regardless of how many years they have been practicing.
acceptables: Only those who provide proof of having completed the training will be able to apply for the license, regardless of the number of years they have been working in the field.
Only people who can show that they have completed the training may apply for the license, irrespective of how many years they have been engaged in the activity.

traps.comment: US target: license, not licence.
traps.label: licence (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: solo limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: solo omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: formación (professional) = training. 'Formation' is a shape or a geological structure.
traps.label: formación rendered as 'the formation'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No bien se difundió la noticia, la oficina comenzó a recibir llamadas de personas que querían saber si sus contratos seguían vigentes.
why_this_chunk: No bien = As soon as / No sooner… than; vigentes = in effect / in force.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No bien: a time expression. What pairs with No sooner?
english_key: No sooner had the news spread than the office began receiving calls from people who wanted to know whether their contracts were still in effect.
acceptables: As soon as the news got out, the office started receiving calls from people who wanted to know whether their contracts were still valid.
The moment the news spread, the office began to receive calls from people wanting to know if their contracts were still in force.

traps.comment: No sooner… pairs with than, not when.
traps.label: No sooner… when
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: No bien = As soon as / No sooner. 'Not well' is a calque.
traps.ok: No sooner had the news spread
traps.label: no bien calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: vigente / entrar en vigor = in effect / in force / take effect. 'Vigent' and 'vigor' are not US legal English here.
traps.label: vigente rendered as vigent / vigor
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El testigo afirmó que había visto salir a dos personas del edificio, pero no pudo decir si una de ellas llevaba la carpeta desaparecida.
why_this_chunk: see + object + bare verb (seen two people leave); carpeta = folder / file; desaparecida = missing.
suggested_ok_english_hint: había visto salir a dos personas: English word order? And carpeta?
english_key: The witness stated that he had seen two people leave the building but could not say whether one of them was carrying the missing folder.
acceptables: The witness said that he had seen two people leaving the building, but he could not say whether either of them was carrying the missing folder.
The witness claimed that he had seen two people come out of the building but was unable to say if one of them had the missing file.

traps.comment: había visto salir a dos personas = had seen two people leave. English puts the object before the verb.
traps.label: see + object + verb
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: carpeta desaparecida = missing folder. 'Disappeared' is not used as an adjective this way.
traps.label: desaparecido rendered as 'disappeared folder'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: carpeta = folder / file. A carpet is a rug.
traps.label: carpeta rendered as 'the missing carpet'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Aun aceptando que la primera estimación fue demasiado optimista, los responsables sostienen que el proyecto puede completarse sin reducir su alcance.
why_this_chunk: Aun = even (aún = still); los responsables = those responsible / those in charge; sostener = maintain.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Aun (no accent) or aún (accent)? They mean different things. And los responsables?
english_key: Even accepting that the first estimate was too optimistic, those responsible maintain that the project can be completed without reducing its scope.
acceptables: Even if one accepts that the initial estimate was overly optimistic, those in charge maintain that the project can be completed without scaling it back.
Even granting that the first estimate was too optimistic, the officials in charge argue that the project can be finished without reducing its scope.

traps.comment: Aun without an accent = even. Aún with an accent = still. 'Still accepting' misreads the source.
traps.label: Aun read as aún (still)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: los responsables = those responsible / those in charge. 'Responsible' is an adjective and has no plural.
traps.label: responsibles
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: sostener que = maintain / argue that. 'Sustain' means support or suffer.
traps.label: sostener rendered as 'sustain'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La empresa de mensajería se comprometió a entregar los paquetes antes del mediodía o, de no ser posible, a informar de la demora a sus destinatarios.
why_this_chunk: comprometerse a = undertake / commit to (not compromise); de no ser posible = if that was not possible / failing that.
suggested_ok_english_hint: se comprometió a / de no ser posible: two traps in one line.
english_key: The courier company undertook to deliver the packages before noon or, if that was not possible, to notify the recipients of the delay.
acceptables: The courier service committed to delivering the packages before noon or, if this was not possible, to inform the recipients of the delay.
The delivery company promised to deliver the parcels before midday or, failing that, to notify the addressees of the delay.

traps.comment: empresa de mensajería = courier / delivery company. 'Messaging company' suggests texting apps.
traps.label: mensajería rendered as 'The messaging company'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: comprometerse a = undertake / commit / promise to. 'Compromise' means settle by concession or endanger.
traps.label: comprometerse rendered as 'compromised to deliver'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

detector.pattern: \bof not being possible\b|\bof not to be\b

traps.comment: de no ser posible = if that was not possible / failing that. 'Of not being possible' is a calque.
traps.label: de + inf. conditional calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Entre quienes respondieron a la encuesta había personas que nunca habían utilizado el servicio y otras que llevaban años haciéndolo.
why_this_chunk: Inverted 'Among X were people' (plural verb); llevar años + -ndo = had been doing it for years.
suggested_ok_english_hint: había personas: singular in Spanish, but what about English? And llevaban años haciéndolo?
english_key: Among those who responded to the survey were people who had never used the service and others who had been using it for years.
acceptables: The survey respondents included people who had never used the service and others who had been using it for years.
Among the survey respondents were people who had never used the service and others who had used it for years.

traps.comment: había personas = there were people / were people. The verb agrees with the plural noun in English.
traps.label: was people
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: llevaban años haciéndolo = had been using it for years. 'Carried years' is a calque.
traps.ok: had been using it for years
traps.label: llevar + time calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: A diferencia de la edición anterior, el catálogo incluirá las obras cedidas temporalmente por coleccionistas particulares, pero no indicará su valor comercial.
why_this_chunk: cedidas temporalmente = on loan; particular = private; US catalog.
suggested_ok_english_hint: obras cedidas temporalmente / coleccionistas particulares: two false friends. And US spelling of catálogo?
english_key: Unlike the previous edition, the catalog will include works on temporary loan from private collectors, but will not indicate their market value.
acceptables: Unlike the previous edition, the catalog will include works lent temporarily by private collectors but will not state their commercial value.
In contrast to the previous edition, the catalog will include works loaned temporarily by private collectors, but it will not indicate their market value.

traps.comment: US target: catalog, not catalogue.
traps.label: catalogue (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: coleccionistas particulares = private collectors. 'Particular' means specific or fussy.
traps.label: particular rendered as 'particular collectors'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: obras cedidas temporalmente = works on (temporary) loan / lent. 'Ceded' means given up for good.
traps.label: ceder rendered as 'ceded temporarily'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Por el hecho de haber participado en una protesta, ningún estudiante debería perder el derecho a presentar los exámenes programados.
errors_to_catch: presentar rendered as 'present the scheduled exams'
why_this_chunk: presentar un examen = take an exam; Por el hecho de = merely for / just because; programados = scheduled.
suggested_ok_english_hint: presentar exámenes in Latin America means…? And Por el hecho de?
english_key: No student should lose the right to take the scheduled exams merely for having participated in a protest.
acceptables: Merely for having taken part in a protest, no student should lose the right to take the scheduled exams.
No student should lose the right to take the scheduled examinations just because he or she participated in a protest.

traps.comment: presentar un examen (Latin America) = take an exam. 'Present an exam' means hand it out or display it.
traps.label: presentar rendered as 'present the scheduled exams'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Por el hecho de haber… = merely for having / just because. 'For the fact of' is a calque.
traps.label: por el hecho de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: exámenes programados = scheduled exams. 'Programmed' is for machines.
traps.label: programado rendered as 'programmed exams'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El director aseguró que el informe estaría listo para el lunes siguiente, aunque todavía no se habían recibido los resultados de dos laboratorios.
why_this_chunk: asegurar que (no listener) = give assurances / state / insist; estaría = would be; todavía no = not yet.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aseguró que: does English 'assure' work without a person? Keep todavía and the past-future.
english_key: The director gave assurances that the report would be ready by the following Monday, even though the results from two laboratories had not yet been received.
acceptables: The director stated that the report would be ready by the following Monday, although the results from two of the laboratories had not yet come in.
The director insisted that the report would be ready by the next Monday, although results from two laboratories had still not been received.

traps.comment: todavía no = not yet / still not. Without it the results sound simply missing, not late.
traps.label: todavía omitted (yet)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: aseguró que (no listener) = gave assurances / stated / insisted that. English 'assure' needs a person: assured the board that….
traps.label: assured that (no object)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: After a past reporting verb, estaría = would be. 'Will be' breaks the sequence of tenses.
traps.label: will after a past verb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

spanish_text: Sea por desconocimiento de las normas o por falta de recursos, muchas pequeñas empresas no presentan sus declaraciones dentro del plazo establecido.
why_this_chunk: Sea por… o por = Whether because of… or; declaraciones = (tax) returns; presentar = file.
suggested_ok_english_hint: declaraciones in a tax sentence, and Sea por… o por: which English frame?
english_key: Whether because of unfamiliarity with the rules or a lack of resources, many small businesses do not file their returns within the established deadline.
acceptables: Whether due to a lack of knowledge of the regulations or to a lack of resources, many small businesses fail to file their tax returns by the established deadline.
Be it from ignorance of the rules or from lack of resources, many small companies do not submit their returns within the set deadline.

traps.comment: declaraciones (de impuestos) = tax returns. 'Declarations' are formal statements.
traps.label: declaración rendered as 'their declarations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Sea por… o por… = Whether because of… or…. 'Be it for' is a calque.
traps.label: sea por… o por calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: presentar una declaración = file a return. 'Present' is a calque.
traps.label: presentar rendered as 'present their returns'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Los científicos no lograron confirmar que el fenómeno fuera permanente ni descartar que las variaciones se debieran a causas estacionales.
errors_to_catch: lograr rendered as 'did not achieve to confirm'
why_this_chunk: descartar = rule out; after a negative, ni = or; no lograr = be unable to.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no lograron confirmar… ni descartar: what is descartar, and does ni become nor?
english_key: The scientists were unable to confirm that the phenomenon was permanent or to rule out that the variations were due to seasonal causes.
acceptables: The scientists did not manage to confirm that the phenomenon was permanent or to rule out the possibility that the variations were due to seasonal causes.
The scientists failed to confirm that the phenomenon was permanent and could not rule out that the variations stemmed from seasonal causes.

traps.comment: descartar (una hipótesis) = rule out. 'Discard' means throw away.
traps.label: descartar rendered as 'to discard'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: After a negative (were unable to… ni…), English continues with or: unable to confirm… or to rule out. 'Nor' here is a double negative.
traps.label: not… nor
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: no lograr + inf. = be unable to / fail to / not manage to. 'Did not achieve to confirm' is a calque.
traps.label: lograr rendered as 'did not achieve to confirm'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La carta que recibió Marta el martes era una copia; el original, que había sido enviado por correo certificado, nunca llegó a su domicilio.
why_this_chunk: Keep the semicolon; capitalize days of the week; domicilio = home / address.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Two independent clauses around a semicolon, a day of the week, and domicilio.
english_key: The letter that Marta received on Tuesday was a copy; the original, which had been sent by certified mail, never reached her home.
acceptables: The letter Marta received on Tuesday was a copy; the original, which had been sent by certified mail, never arrived at her home.
The letter that Marta got on Tuesday was a copy; the original, sent by certified mail, never reached her address.

traps.comment: English capitalizes days of the week (Tuesday).
traps.label: lowercase weekday
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: domicilio = home / address. 'Domicile' is a legal-residence term.
traps.label: domicilio rendered as 'her domicile'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Siempre y cuando los datos personales se eliminen correctamente, las grabaciones podrán conservarse con fines de investigación durante otros tres años.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: Siempre y cuando = provided that / as long as; otros tres años = another three years / three more years; con fines de = for… purposes.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Siempre y cuando: always? And otros tres años?
english_key: Provided that personal data are properly deleted, the recordings may be kept for research purposes for another three years.
acceptables: As long as the personal data is properly removed, the recordings may be retained for research purposes for three more years.
Provided that personal data are deleted correctly, the recordings can be kept for another three years for research purposes.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: otros tres años = another three years / three more years. 'Other three years' is a calque.
traps.label: other + number
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: con fines de investigación = for research purposes. 'Research ends' is a calque.
traps.label: fines rendered as 'research ends'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La propuesta no reduce las obligaciones de los propietarios, pero sí establece un procedimiento más sencillo para demostrar que las han cumplido.
why_this_chunk: Emphatic sí = do / does + verb (it does establish); cumplir obligaciones = fulfill / meet obligations.
suggested_ok_english_hint: pero sí establece: what does that sí add, and how does English show it?
english_key: The proposal does not reduce owners' obligations, but it does establish a simpler procedure for demonstrating that they have fulfilled them.
acceptables: The proposal does not lessen the obligations of property owners, but it does set up a simpler procedure for proving that they have met them.
The proposal does not reduce the owners' obligations; it does, however, establish a simpler procedure to show that they have complied with them.

traps.comment: pero sí establece: the emphatic sí contrasts with the negative. English shows it with does (it does establish).
traps.label: emphatic sí dropped
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: cumplir (obligaciones) = fulfill / meet / comply with. 'Accomplished' is for tasks or goals.
traps.label: cumplir rendered as 'accomplished them'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Al mismo tiempo que aumentaba la producción, disminuía la cantidad de agua utilizada por unidad, circunstancia que los técnicos atribuyeron a mejoras en los equipos.
why_this_chunk: Subject before verb in English; equipos = equipment (uncountable).
suggested_ok_english_hint: disminuía la cantidad: Spanish puts the verb first. Where does the English subject go? And equipos?
