english_key: As production increased, the amount of water used per unit decreased, a circumstance that the technicians attributed to equipment improvements.
acceptables: While production was increasing, the amount of water used per unit was decreasing, something the technicians attributed to improvements in the equipment.
At the same time as production rose, the quantity of water used per unit fell, which the technicians attributed to improvements in the equipment.

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Spanish inverts verb and subject (disminuía la cantidad); English needs subject + verb: the amount of water decreased.
traps.ok: the amount of water used per unit decreased
traps.no: decreased the amount of water used per unit
traps.label: verb–subject order calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Si se confirma que el cuadro fue pintado después de la fecha que figura en el catálogo, será necesario revisar su atribución.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
errors_to_catch: figurar rendered as 'the date that figures in'
why_this_chunk: cuadro = painting; figurar = appear / be shown; si + present.
suggested_ok_english_hint: cuadro / figurar: two cognate traps. What tense after 'If' with a future result?
english_key: If it is confirmed that the painting was created after the date shown in the catalog, its attribution will have to be reviewed.
acceptables: If it is confirmed that the painting was done after the date given in the catalog, its attribution will need to be revised.
Should it be confirmed that the picture was painted after the date that appears in the catalog, it will be necessary to review its attribution.

traps.comment: cuadro (art) = painting / picture. 'Frame' or 'square' are other senses.
traps.label: cuadro rendered as 'the frame'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: si (condition) + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

traps.comment: figurar en el catálogo = appear / be shown / be listed in the catalog. 'Figures in' is a calque.
traps.label: figurar rendered as 'the date that figures in'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Lo que algunos consideran un gasto innecesario, otros lo ven como una inversión que permitirá evitar reparaciones mucho más costosas.
why_this_chunk: Fronted object: no resumptive it in English; permitir + inf. needs an object or 'make it possible to'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Lo que algunos…, otros lo ven: does English repeat the object as 'it'? And permitirá evitar?
english_key: What some consider an unnecessary expense, others see as an investment that will make it possible to avoid much more costly repairs.
acceptables: What some regard as an unnecessary expense, others see as an investment that will help avoid far more expensive repairs.
What some people consider unnecessary spending, others view as an investment that will prevent much costlier repairs.

traps.comment: Lo que algunos consideran…, otros lo ven: when the object is fronted with What, English does not repeat it (others see as…).
traps.label: resumptive it
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Ni el reconocimiento público ni las compensaciones ofrecidas consiguieron que las familias retiraran las denuncias presentadas contra la compañía.
why_this_chunk: Neither… nor; denuncias = complaints / charges; conseguir que X haga = get / persuade X to do.
suggested_ok_english_hint: ni… ni; denuncias; conseguir que: three classic traps.
english_key: Neither public recognition nor the compensation offered persuaded the families to withdraw the complaints they had filed against the company.
acceptables: Neither the public recognition nor the compensation offered succeeded in getting the families to withdraw the complaints filed against the company.
Neither public acknowledgment nor the compensation that was offered managed to get the families to drop the complaints they had filed against the company.

traps.comment: ni… ni = neither… nor. 'Neither… or' is a nonparallel pair.
traps.label: neither paired with or
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: denuncia = complaint / report / charge. 'Denunciation' is public condemnation.
traps.label: denuncia rendered as 'the denunciations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: conseguir que + subjunctive = get / persuade someone to do something. 'Achieved that the families…' is a calque.
traps.label: conseguir que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El convenio permite compartir instalaciones y personal, siempre que ninguna de las entidades pierda autonomía para decidir sobre sus propios programas.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: siempre que = provided that; permitir + inf. needs an object (allows X to be shared / allows the institutions to share); entidad = organization.
suggested_ok_english_hint: siempre que: condition or 'always'? And can 'allows to share' stand without an object?
english_key: The agreement allows facilities and staff to be shared, provided that neither organization loses the autonomy to decide on its own programs.
acceptables: The agreement permits the sharing of facilities and personnel, as long as neither organization loses the autonomy to make decisions about its own programs.
The agreement allows the institutions to share facilities and staff, provided that neither of them loses its autonomy to decide on its own programs.

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.ok: allows facilities and staff to be shared
traps.no: allows to share facilities and staff
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: entidad = organization / institution / agency. 'Entity' is stiff legalese in US English.
traps.label: entidad rendered as 'neither entity'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Desde que se inauguró la carretera, los accidentes han disminuido, aunque todavía no se dispone de cifras comparables para todos los municipios.
errors_to_catch: disponer de rendered as 'it does not yet dispose of comparable figures'
why_this_chunk: Since… + present perfect (have decreased); no se dispone de = are not available; todavía = yet.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Desde que + han disminuido: which English tense with since? And no se dispone de?
english_key: Since the highway opened, accidents have decreased, although comparable figures are not yet available for all municipalities.
acceptables: Accidents have declined since the road was opened, although comparable figures are not yet available for every municipality.
Since the highway opened, there have been fewer accidents, although comparable data are not yet available for all of the municipalities.

traps.comment: todavía no = not yet. Dropping it removes the expectation that figures will come.
traps.label: todavía omitted (yet)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Desde que… han disminuido: with since + a continuing period, English uses the present perfect (have decreased).
traps.label: simple past with since
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: no se dispone de = are not available / we do not have. 'Dispose of' means get rid of.
traps.ok: comparable figures are not yet available
traps.no: it does not yet dispose of comparable figures
traps.label: disponer de rendered as 'it does not yet dispose of comparable figures'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Más vale reconocer una demora que anunciar una fecha de entrega que no pueda cumplirse sin comprometer la seguridad de los trabajadores.
why_this_chunk: Más vale X que Y = It is better to X than to Y (than, not that).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Más vale… que: English has a fixed frame for this.
english_key: It is better to acknowledge a delay than to announce a delivery date that cannot be met without compromising workers' safety.
acceptables: Better to admit a delay than to announce a delivery date that cannot be met without jeopardizing the safety of the workers.
It is better to acknowledge a delay than to set a delivery date that cannot be met without endangering workers' safety.

traps.comment: Más vale X que Y = It is better to X than (to) Y. 'More is worth' is a calque.
traps.no: It is worth more to acknowledge
traps.label: más vale calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: better… than. 'That' is a calque of que.
traps.label: better… that
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: El funcionario explicó que no debía confundirse la autorización para iniciar las obras con la aprobación definitiva del proyecto.
errors_to_catch: no deber read as no tener que
why_this_chunk: no deber = must not / should not (prohibition), not 'did not have to'; obras = construction / the work.
suggested_ok_english_hint: no debía confundirse: must not, or did not have to? And obras?
english_key: The official explained that authorization to begin construction should not be confused with final approval of the project.
acceptables: The official explained that permission to start the work must not be confused with the definitive approval of the project.
The official explained that the authorization to start construction was not to be confused with the project's final approval.

traps.comment: no debía confundirse = should not / must not be confused (a warning). 'Did not have to' means it was unnecessary.
traps.no: did not have to be confused
traps.label: no deber read as no tener que
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: obras = construction / the work (mass noun). 'The works' is British or reads as 'everything'.
traps.label: obras rendered as 'begin the works'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: funcionario = official / civil servant. 'Functionary' is pejorative in English.
traps.label: funcionario rendered as 'The functionary'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Cuando por fin se publicaron las actas, resultó evidente que varias recomendaciones habían sido omitidas de la versión difundida al público.
why_this_chunk: actas = minutes (plural verb); resultar evidente = become clear / be evident.
suggested_ok_english_hint: actas of a meeting: what are they? And resultó evidente?
english_key: When the minutes were finally published, it became clear that several recommendations had been omitted from the version released to the public.
acceptables: When the minutes were at last published, it became evident that several recommendations had been left out of the version made public.
When the minutes were finally released, it was clear that several recommendations had been omitted from the version distributed to the public.

traps.comment: actas (de una reunión) = minutes. 'Acts' are laws or deeds.
traps.label: acta rendered as 'the acts'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: resultó evidente = it became clear / it was evident. 'It resulted evident' is a calque.
traps.label: resultar + adj. calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: minutes (of a meeting) is plural: the minutes were.
traps.label: minutes was
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: No es que la aplicación resulte difícil de usar, sino que sus instrucciones presuponen conocimientos que muchos usuarios no tienen.
why_this_chunk: No es que X, sino que Y = It is not that X but (rather) that Y; conocimientos = knowledge (uncountable).
suggested_ok_english_hint: No es que… sino que: what does sino become? And conocimientos?
english_key: It is not that the app is difficult to use, but rather that its instructions assume knowledge that many users do not have.
acceptables: It is not that the application is hard to use; rather, its instructions presuppose knowledge that many users lack.
The problem is not that the app is difficult to use but that its instructions take for granted knowledge that many users do not have.

traps.comment: sino que after a negative = but (rather) that. 'If not that' (si no) changes the meaning.
traps.label: sino rendered as if not
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: resulte difícil = is difficult. 'Results difficult' is a calque.
traps.label: resultar + adj. calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: conocimientos = knowledge, uncountable in English.
traps.label: knowledges
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

spanish_text: La decisión se comunicó a todos los afectados, incluidos aquellos cuyos nombres no aparecían en la lista publicada inicialmente.
why_this_chunk: the affected → those affected; incluidos = including; cuyos = whose.
suggested_ok_english_hint: los afectados / incluidos / cuyos: three structure traps in one line.
english_key: The decision was communicated to all those affected, including those whose names did not appear on the initially published list.
acceptables: The decision was communicated to everyone affected, including those whose names had not appeared on the list published initially.
All those affected were notified of the decision, including people whose names did not appear on the list that was originally published.

traps.comment: los afectados = those affected / the people affected. 'All the affected' is a calque.
traps.label: the affected (adjective as noun)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: incluidos (absolute) = including. 'Included those' reads as a main verb.
traps.label: included for including
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: cuyos nombres = whose names. 'Those who their names' is a calque.
traps.label: cuyo calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Relative pronouns, p. 49

spanish_text: Por mucho que mejoren las condiciones del mercado, las familias no recuperarán de inmediato los ahorros perdidos durante la crisis.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: Por mucho que = However much / No matter how much + present; de inmediato = immediately.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por mucho que + subjunctive: a concession. And watch 'de inmediato' or the meaning flips.
english_key: However much market conditions improve, families will not immediately recover the savings they lost during the crisis.
acceptables: No matter how much market conditions improve, families will not recover the savings lost during the crisis right away.
However much the market conditions may improve, families will not immediately regain the savings they lost during the crisis.

traps.comment: Por mucho que = However much / No matter how much. 'For much that' is a calque.
traps.label: por mucho que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: \b(immediately|right away|at once|straight away|in the short term|soon)\b

traps.comment: de inmediato = immediately. Without it the sentence says families will never recover their savings.
traps.label: de inmediato omitted (meaning flips)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: por mucho que + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: El comité pidió explicaciones tanto sobre el origen de los fondos como sobre la forma en que se habían seleccionado los beneficiarios.
errors_to_catch: forma rendered as 'the form in which the beneficiaries'
why_this_chunk: tanto… como = both… and; la forma en que = how / the way in which.
suggested_ok_english_hint: tanto sobre… como sobre: which English pair? And la forma en que?
english_key: The committee requested explanations both about the origin of the funds and about how the beneficiaries had been selected.
acceptables: The committee asked for explanations both about the source of the funds and about the way in which the beneficiaries had been selected.
The committee requested an explanation of both the origin of the funds and the manner in which the beneficiaries had been chosen.

traps.comment: tanto… como = both… and. 'Both… as' is nonparallel.
traps.label: both… as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: la forma en que = how / the way in which. 'The form in which' refers to shape.
traps.no: the form in which the beneficiaries
traps.label: forma rendered as 'the form in which the beneficiaries'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: pedir explicaciones = ask for / request explanations. 'Asked explanations' drops the preposition.
traps.label: asked without for
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: Las medidas anunciadas podrían resultar eficaces a corto plazo; a largo plazo, sin embargo, exigirán una coordinación que hasta ahora ha faltado.
errors_to_catch: eficaz rendered as 'efficient in the short'
why_this_chunk: Semicolon before the second clause; eficaz = effective (eficiente = efficient); resultar eficaz = prove effective.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Keep the semicolon. Eficaces: effective or efficient?
english_key: The announced measures could prove effective in the short term; in the long term, however, they will require a level of coordination that has been lacking so far.
acceptables: The measures announced might be effective in the short run; in the long run, however, they will require coordination that has been missing until now.
The announced measures could turn out to be effective in the short term; over the long term, however, they will demand coordination that has so far been lacking.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: resultar eficaces = prove / turn out to be effective. 'Result effective' is a calque.
traps.label: resultar + adj. calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: eficaz = effective (it works). 'Efficient' (eficiente) means without waste.
traps.label: eficaz rendered as 'efficient in the short'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El informe advierte que dos de cada cinco hogares destinan más de la tercera parte de sus ingresos al pago del alquiler.
errors_to_catch: tercera parte rendered as 'the third part of'
why_this_chunk: advertir = warn; dos de cada cinco = two out of (every) five; la tercera parte = a third.
suggested_ok_english_hint: advierte; dos de cada cinco; la tercera parte: three fixed expressions.
english_key: The report warns that two out of every five households spend more than a third of their income on rent.
acceptables: The report warns that two in five households allocate more than one-third of their income to paying rent.
The report cautions that two out of five households spend over a third of their income on rent payments.

traps.comment: advertir = warn / caution. 'Advertise' means promote.
traps.label: advertir rendered as 'advertises'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: dos de cada cinco = two out of (every) five / two in five. 'Two of each five' is a calque.
traps.label: de cada calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: la tercera parte = a third / one-third. 'The third part' is a calque.
traps.label: tercera parte rendered as 'the third part of'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Si hubiera llegado a saberse que los documentos eran falsos antes de la firma, la operación no se habría llevado a cabo.
focus: If… had, not if… would have
why_this_chunk: Unreal past: If it had become known… would not have; la firma = the signing (not the firm); llegar a saberse = become known.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Si hubiera llegado a saberse: which English if-clause? And la firma here?
english_key: If it had become known before the signing that the documents were forged, the transaction would not have gone ahead.
acceptables: Had it come to light before the signing that the documents were false, the transaction would not have been carried out.
If it had been discovered before the signing that the documents were fake, the operation would not have taken place.

traps.comment: la firma (act of signing) = the signing / signature. 'The firm' is a company.
traps.label: firma rendered as 'the firm'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: In an unreal past condition the if-clause takes the past perfect (If X had…), never would have.
traps.no: If it would have become known
traps.pitfall: If… had, not if… would have
traps.label: would have in the if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: llegar a saberse = become known / come to light. 'Arrived to be known' is a calque.
traps.label: llegar a + inf. calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La embajada recomendó conservar una copia del pasaporte y comunicar cualquier pérdida a las autoridades locales tan pronto como fuera posible.
why_this_chunk: recommend + -ing (both verbs parallel); conservar = keep; comunicar una pérdida = report a loss.
suggested_ok_english_hint: recomendó conservar… y comunicar: two parallel verbs. What form after recommend, and what is comunicar a loss?
english_key: The embassy recommended keeping a copy of the passport and reporting any loss to the local authorities as soon as possible.
acceptables: The embassy advised keeping a copy of your passport and reporting any loss to the local authorities as soon as possible.
The embassy recommended that people keep a copy of their passport and report any loss to local authorities as soon as possible.

traps.comment: recomendar + inf. (no person) = recommend + -ing, or recommend that people keep. 'Recommended to keep' needs an object.
traps.label: recommended to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Both verbs depend on recommended: keeping… and reporting….
traps.label: mixed -ing and to
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: comunicar una pérdida = report a loss. 'Communicate a loss' is a calque.
traps.label: comunicar rendered as 'communicating any loss'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Algunas escuelas disponen de equipos modernos, mientras que otras todavía comparten un solo computador entre varias aulas.
errors_to_catch: disponer de rendered as 'dispose of modern equipment'
why_this_chunk: disponer de = have; equipos = equipment (uncountable); todavía = still; computador (Colombia) = computer.
suggested_ok_english_hint: disponen de / equipos / todavía: keep all three right.
english_key: Some schools have modern equipment, while others still share a single computer among several classrooms.
acceptables: Some schools have up-to-date equipment, whereas others still share one computer among several classrooms.
Some schools are equipped with modern computers, while others are still sharing a single computer between several classrooms.

traps.comment: todavía = still. Without it the contrast between modern and backward schools is weaker.
traps.label: todavía omitted (still)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: disponer de = have / be equipped with. 'Dispose of' means get rid of.
traps.label: disponer de rendered as 'dispose of modern equipment'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La resolución establece que las notificaciones enviadas después de las cinco de la tarde se entenderán recibidas el siguiente día hábil.
why_this_chunk: se entenderán recibidas = shall be deemed received; día hábil = business day; US time format.
suggested_ok_english_hint: se entenderán recibidas / día hábil: legal formulas with fixed English equivalents.
english_key: The resolution provides that notices sent after 5 p.m. shall be deemed received on the next business day.
acceptables: The resolution states that notifications sent after five in the afternoon will be considered received on the following business day.
The resolution establishes that notices sent after 5:00 p.m. will be deemed to have been received on the next business day.

traps.comment: se entenderán recibidas (legal fiction) = shall be deemed / considered received. 'Understood received' is a calque.
traps.label: entenderse + participle calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: día hábil = business day. 'Able day' is a calque.
traps.label: hábil rendered as 'able day'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: US prose uses the 12-hour clock: 5 p.m. / five in the afternoon.
traps.label: 24-hour clock
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Numbers, p. 37

spanish_text: Aun cuando los resultados coincidan con los obtenidos en estudios anteriores, eso no demuestra que se hayan utilizado procedimientos idénticos.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: Aun cuando + subjunctive = even if (hypothetical); present tense after if.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Aun cuando + subjunctive: is the match a fact or a hypothesis?
english_key: Even if the results match those obtained in previous studies, that does not prove that identical procedures were used.
acceptables: Even if the results coincide with those obtained in earlier studies, this does not demonstrate that identical procedures were used.
Even if the results agree with those of previous studies, that does not show that the same procedures were used.

traps.comment: Aun cuando + subjunctive (coincidan) is hypothetical = even if. 'Even though' asserts that the results do match.
traps.label: even though for a hypothesis
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: aun cuando + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: Ni siquiera está claro si los pagos realizados durante el período de prueba serán descontados del importe final del contrato.
errors_to_catch: período de prueba rendered as 'test period'
why_this_chunk: importe = amount; período de prueba = trial period; descontar = deduct.
suggested_ok_english_hint: importe / período de prueba / descontar: three cognate traps.
english_key: It is not even clear whether payments made during the trial period will be deducted from the final contract amount.
acceptables: It is not even clear if the payments made during the trial period will be subtracted from the final amount of the contract.
Even whether the payments made during the trial period will be deducted from the contract's final amount is unclear.

traps.comment: importe = amount / sum. 'Import' means bring goods into a country.
traps.label: importe rendered as 'contract import'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: período de prueba = trial / probationary period. 'Test period' is a calque.
traps.label: período de prueba rendered as 'test period'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: descontar del importe = deduct from. 'Discount' means reduce a price.
traps.label: descontar rendered as 'discounted from'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El investigador pidió que nadie divulgara los nombres de las personas entrevistadas, aunque estas hubieran autorizado la publicación de sus declaraciones.
why_this_chunk: aunque + pluperfect subjunctive = even if (hypothetical); asked that no one disclose (mandative subjunctive); declaraciones = statements.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aunque + hubieran: fact or hypothesis? And what verb form after 'asked that'?
english_key: The researcher asked that no one disclose the names of the people interviewed, even if they had authorized publication of their statements.
acceptables: The researcher requested that nobody reveal the names of the interviewees, even if the latter had authorized the publication of their statements.
The researcher asked that no one divulge the names of the persons interviewed, even if those persons had consented to the publication of their statements.

traps.comment: After asked that…, US English uses the present (mandative) subjunctive: that X be…, that X identify…. The indicative is marked. 'should + verb' is also accepted.
traps.label: indicative after asked that
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

traps.comment: aunque + hubieran autorizado is hypothetical = even if. 'Even though' asserts that they did authorize it.
traps.label: even though for a hypothesis
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: declaraciones (interview) = statements. 'Declarations' are formal proclamations.
traps.label: declaración rendered as 'their declarations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: El mercado, al que acudían agricultores de toda la provincia, cerró temporalmente después de que se detectaran daños en la estructura del techo.
why_this_chunk: Nonrestrictive clause with commas; después de que + clause = after + clause (no 'that'); daños = damage.
suggested_ok_english_hint: al que acudían: one known market, so how is the clause punctuated? And después de que?
english_key: The market, to which farmers from all over the province came, closed temporarily after damage was detected in the roof structure.
acceptables: The market, which farmers from across the province used to visit, was temporarily closed after damage to the roof structure was detected.
The market, where farmers from throughout the province would come, closed temporarily after damage was found in the structure of the roof.

traps.comment: The market is already identified; the clause is nonrestrictive and must be set off by commas (not dashes).
traps.label: nonrestrictive commas missing
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Restrictive and nonrestrictive clauses and appositives, p. 48

traps.comment: después de que = after (conjunction). 'After that' changes the meaning to 'later'.
traps.label: after that
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: daños (physical) = damage, uncountable. 'Damages' is legal compensation.
traps.label: daños rendered as 'damages were detected'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Si no se explica que cambió el método de cálculo, las cifras podrían interpretarse como una reducción de las pérdidas cuando en realidad reflejan un cambio de criterio contable.
why_this_chunk: Subject before verb (the method has changed); passive se = could be interpreted; criterio contable = accounting criteria.
suggested_ok_english_hint: que cambió el método: where does the English subject go? And podrían interpretarse?
english_key: If it is not explained that the calculation method has changed, the figures could be interpreted as a reduction in losses when they actually reflect a change in accounting criteria.
acceptables: If it is not explained that the calculation method changed, the figures could be read as a decrease in losses when they actually reflect a change in accounting policy.
Without an explanation that the method of calculation was changed, the figures might be interpreted as a reduction in losses, whereas in reality they reflect a change in accounting criteria.

traps.comment: que cambió el método: English needs subject + verb (the calculation method has changed).
traps.ok: that the calculation method has changed
traps.label: verb–subject order calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: podrían interpretarse = could be interpreted (passive se). 'Could interpret themselves' is a calque.
traps.label: passive se calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: criterio contable = accounting criteria / policy. 'Accountant' is a person.
traps.label: contable rendered as 'accountant criteria'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La gerente, así como los responsables de las sucursales, deberá explicar por qué los pedidos pendientes no se registraron en el sistema.
focus: as well as: verb agrees with first subject
errors_to_catch: plural verb after as well as
registrar rendered as 'registered in the system'
why_this_chunk: With as well as, the verb agrees with the first subject (The manager… is); los responsables = the heads.
suggested_ok_english_hint: La gerente, así como…, deberá: what does the verb agree with?
english_key: The manager, as well as the branch heads, is required to explain why the pending orders were not recorded in the system.
acceptables: The manager, along with the heads of the branches, will have to explain why the outstanding orders were not entered into the system.
The manager and the branch managers will have to explain why the pending orders were not recorded in the system.

traps.comment: X, as well as Y, takes a verb that agrees with X (singular here: deberá = is required).
traps.pitfall: as well as: verb agrees with first subject
traps.label: plural verb after as well as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: los responsables = the heads / those in charge. 'Responsible' is an adjective and has no plural.
traps.label: responsibles
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: registrar pedidos = record / enter orders. 'Registered' suggests official enrollment.
traps.label: registrar rendered as 'registered in the system'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No fue hasta después de leer el contrato completo cuando los compradores descubrieron que el servicio adicional tenía un costo mensual.
why_this_chunk: It was not until… that… (never when); después de + inf. = after + -ing (no 'of').
suggested_ok_english_hint: No fue hasta… cuando: what does English use after the cleft?
english_key: It was not until they had read the entire contract that the buyers discovered that the additional service had a monthly charge.
acceptables: Only after reading the entire contract did the buyers discover that the additional service carried a monthly cost.
It was not until after reading the full contract that the buyers found out that the extra service had a monthly cost.

traps.comment: No fue hasta… cuando = It was not until… that. 'When' is a calque of the Spanish cleft.
traps.label: not until… when
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: después de + inf. = after + -ing. 'After of' is a calque.
traps.label: after of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: La importancia de una prueba no depende únicamente de su precisión, sino también de que pueda repetirse en condiciones semejantes.
why_this_chunk: not only… but also; depend on (twice); de que pueda = on whether it can.
suggested_ok_english_hint: sino también de que pueda: which English pair, and which link word?
english_key: The importance of a test depends not only on its accuracy but also on whether it can be repeated under similar conditions.
acceptables: The importance of a test does not depend solely on its precision, but also on its being repeatable under similar conditions.
How important a test is depends not only on how accurate it is but also on whether it can be repeated in similar conditions.

traps.comment: sino también = but also. 'If not also' (si no) changes the meaning.
traps.label: sino rendered as if not
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: depender de = depend on. Keep 'on' in both halves.
traps.label: depend of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: de que pueda repetirse = on whether it can be repeated / on its being repeatable. 'On that it can' is a calque.
traps.label: de que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Aunque la mayoría apoyó la medida, quienes se abstuvieron señalaron que todavía había preguntas esenciales sin respuesta.
why_this_chunk: todavía = still; señalar = point out; abstenerse = abstain (not reflexive in English).
suggested_ok_english_hint: todavía había preguntas: keep todavía. Señalaron and se abstuvieron: two traps.
english_key: Although most supported the measure, those who abstained pointed out that there were still essential questions that had not been answered.
acceptables: Although the majority backed the measure, those who abstained noted that essential questions were still unanswered.
While most people supported the measure, those who abstained pointed out that some essential questions remained unanswered.

traps.comment: todavía = still. Without it the open questions lose their time reference.
traps.label: todavía omitted (still)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: señalar que = point out / note that. 'Signaled' is a calque.
traps.label: señalar rendered as 'signaled'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: abstenerse = abstain (not reflexive in English).
traps.label: abstained themselves
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: En la medida en que disminuya la demanda, los productores podrían verse obligados a almacenar más mercancías de las que pueden vender.
focus: más… de lo que = more… than
Present tense in future time clauses
errors_to_catch: en la medida en que calqued
why_this_chunk: En la medida en que = To the extent that / Insofar as + present; más… de las que = more… than.
suggested_ok_english_hint: En la medida en que + subjunctive / más… de las que: two calque traps.
english_key: To the extent that demand decreases, producers may be forced to store more goods than they can sell.
acceptables: Insofar as demand declines, producers could find themselves forced to stockpile more merchandise than they are able to sell.
As demand falls, producers might be obliged to store more goods than they can sell.

traps.comment: En la medida en que = To the extent that / Insofar as. 'In the measure that' is a calque.
traps.label: en la medida en que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: más mercancías de las que pueden vender = more goods than they can sell. 'More goods of those' is a calque.
traps.pitfall: más… de lo que = more… than
traps.label: more… of those
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

detector.pattern: ^\s*(to the extent that|insofar as|as) demand will\b

traps.comment: en la medida en que + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: El autor negó que su obra se inspirara en hechos reales, pero admitió que algunos personajes se parecían a personas que había conocido.
why_this_chunk: hechos reales = real events; parecerse a = resemble (no 'to'); negó que + subj. = denied that… was.
suggested_ok_english_hint: hechos reales / se parecían a: two easy-to-miss traps. And what follows denied that?
english_key: The author denied that his work was inspired by real events, but admitted that some characters resembled people he had known.
acceptables: The writer denied that his work had been based on real events, but he acknowledged that some of the characters resembled people he had met.
The author denied that his book drew on actual events but conceded that a few characters looked like people he had known.

traps.comment: hechos reales (story) = real / actual events. 'Real facts' is a calque.
traps.label: hechos rendered as 'real facts'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: parecerse a = resemble (transitive, no 'to').
traps.label: resembled to
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: negó que se inspirara = denied that it was inspired. The subjunctive is triggered by negar; it is not a conditional.
traps.label: would after denied
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

spanish_text: Cada vez que se modifica el recorrido, los usuarios deben aprender dónde están las nuevas paradas y cuánto tiempo tardarán en llegar a ellas.
errors_to_catch: question order in an embedded clause
tardar rendered as 'how long they will delay'
why_this_chunk: Embedded questions keep statement order (where the new stops are); tardar = take (time).
suggested_ok_english_hint: dónde están las nuevas paradas: embedded question word order. And tardar?
english_key: Every time the route is changed, users have to learn where the new stops are and how long it will take them to reach them.
acceptables: Whenever the route is modified, passengers must learn where the new stops are located and how long it will take to get to them.
Each time the route changes, riders need to learn where the new stops are and how much time they will need to reach them.

traps.comment: In an embedded question English keeps statement order: where the new stops are.
traps.label: question order in an embedded clause
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: tardar en llegar = take (time) to get there. 'Delay' means postpone or hold up.
traps.ok: how long it will take them
traps.label: tardar rendered as 'how long they will delay'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Ninguna de las declaraciones recogidas en el expediente permite concluir que el acusado conociera el destino final del dinero.
why_this_chunk: declaraciones = statements; expediente = (case) file; permitir + inf. needs an object.
suggested_ok_english_hint: declaraciones / expediente / permite concluir: three legal traps.
english_key: None of the statements contained in the file allows the conclusion that the defendant knew the final destination of the money.
acceptables: None of the statements in the case file makes it possible to conclude that the accused knew the final destination of the money.
Nothing in the statements gathered in the file supports the conclusion that the defendant was aware of where the money ultimately went.

traps.comment: declaraciones (testimony) = statements. 'Declarations' are formal proclamations.
traps.label: declaración rendered as 'declarations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: expediente = (case) file / record. 'Expedient' means convenient.
traps.label: expediente rendered as 'the expedient'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: permitir + infinitive: English needs an object (allowed X to…, made it possible to…). 'Allowed to verb' with no object is ungrammatical.
traps.label: allow to + verb without object
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Tal vez no hubieran surgido tantas discrepancias si las responsabilidades de cada departamento se hubieran definido antes de iniciar el proyecto.
focus: If… had, not if… would have
why_this_chunk: Result = would not have arisen; if-clause = had been defined; keep tal vez.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Tal vez no hubieran surgido… si se hubieran definido: two pluperfect subjunctives, two different English forms.
english_key: Perhaps so many discrepancies would not have arisen if each department's responsibilities had been defined before the project began.
acceptables: Maybe there would not have been so many discrepancies if the responsibilities of each department had been defined before starting the project.
So many disagreements might not have arisen if each department's responsibilities had been defined before the project was launched.

traps.comment: tal vez = perhaps / might. Without it the sentence claims a certainty the source does not.
traps.label: tal vez omitted (certainty added)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: In an unreal past condition the if-clause takes the past perfect (If X had…), never would have.
traps.pitfall: If… had, not if… would have
traps.label: would have in the if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: surgir = arise / emerge. 'Surge' means rise suddenly.
traps.label: surgir rendered as 'surged'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A primera vista, el daño parecía superficial; solo al retirar el revestimiento se descubrió que una viga también estaba deteriorada.
why_this_chunk: Semicolon between clauses; fronted only when… triggers inversion (was it discovered); revestimiento = cladding / covering.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Keep the semicolon. Fronted 'only when…': what happens to the main verb?
english_key: At first glance, the damage seemed superficial; only when the cladding was removed was it discovered that a beam was also deteriorated.
acceptables: At first sight, the damage appeared superficial; it was only on removing the covering that a beam was also found to be deteriorated.
At first glance the damage looked superficial; only when the lining was removed did they discover that a beam had also deteriorated.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

detector.pattern: \bonly when the (cladding|covering|lining) was removed it was\b

traps.comment: A fronted only when… clause requires inversion in the main clause: was it discovered.
traps.label: no inversion after fronted only
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: revestimiento (building) = cladding / covering / lining. 'Revetment' is a retaining wall.
traps.label: revestimiento rendered as 'the revetment'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No importa si la solicitud se presenta por internet o en una oficina: los requisitos de identificación serán exactamente los mismos.
errors_to_catch: importar rendered as 'It does not import if the application'
why_this_chunk: No importa si = Whether… or / It does not matter whether; por internet = online; se presenta = is submitted.
suggested_ok_english_hint: No importa si… o…; por internet; se presenta: three traps in one clause.
english_key: Whether the application is submitted online or at an office, the identification requirements will be exactly the same.
acceptables: It does not matter whether the application is filed online or in person at an office: the identification requirements will be exactly the same.
Regardless of whether the application is submitted online or at an office, the ID requirements will be exactly the same.

traps.comment: No importa = It does not matter. 'Import' means bring in goods.
traps.no: It does not import if the application
traps.label: importar rendered as 'It does not import if the application'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: por internet = online. 'By internet' is a calque.
traps.label: por internet rendered as 'by internet'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: se presenta (la solicitud) = is submitted / filed (passive se). 'Presents itself' is a calque.
traps.label: passive se calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La organización recordó a los asistentes que debían devolver las acreditaciones al salir, pues no serían válidas para las sesiones del día siguiente.
why_this_chunk: asistentes = attendees; acreditaciones = badges / credentials / passes; recordar a alguien = remind.
suggested_ok_english_hint: asistentes / acreditaciones / recordó a: three false-friend traps.
english_key: The organizers reminded attendees that they had to return their badges on leaving, as they would not be valid for the next day's sessions.
acceptables: The organization reminded attendees to return their credentials when leaving, since they would not be valid for the following day's sessions.
The organizers reminded those attending that they must hand back their passes on their way out, because they would not be valid for the sessions the next day.

traps.comment: asistentes (event) = attendees. 'Assistants' are helpers.
traps.label: asistente rendered as 'assistants'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: acreditaciones (event) = badges / credentials / passes. 'Accreditation' is official certification.
traps.label: acreditación rendered as 'their accreditations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: recordar algo a alguien = remind someone. 'Remembered to the attendees' is a calque.
traps.label: recordar = remind
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: De ahí que los especialistas hayan recomendado realizar un seguimiento más prolongado antes de atribuir los cambios a la nueva política.
errors_to_catch: realizar rendered as 'recommended realizing a longer monitoring'
why_this_chunk: De ahí que = Hence / That is why; política (measure) = policy; realizar = carry out (often dropped).
suggested_ok_english_hint: De ahí que: a connector. And política: politics or policy?
english_key: Hence specialists have recommended longer monitoring before attributing the changes to the new policy.
acceptables: That is why specialists have recommended a longer follow-up period before attributing the changes to the new policy.
As a result, the experts have recommended longer-term monitoring before the changes are attributed to the new policy.

traps.comment: De ahí que = Hence / That is why / As a result. 'From there that' is a calque.
traps.label: de ahí que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: política (a measure) = policy. 'Politics' is the activity of government.
traps.label: política rendered as 'new politics'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: realizar un seguimiento = carry out / conduct monitoring. 'Realize' means understand.
traps.label: realizar rendered as 'recommended realizing a longer monitoring'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Unos productores prefieren vender directamente al consumidor; otros consideran más conveniente trabajar con distribuidores que compren cantidades mayores.
why_this_chunk: Semicolon between independent clauses; find it more convenient to….
suggested_ok_english_hint: Keep the semicolon. consideran más conveniente: English needs a dummy object.
english_key: Some producers prefer to sell directly to consumers; others find it more convenient to work with distributors that buy larger quantities.
acceptables: Some producers prefer selling directly to the consumer; others consider it more advantageous to work with distributors who purchase larger quantities.
Some growers prefer to sell straight to consumers, while others find working with distributors that buy in larger quantities more convenient.

traps.comment: Two independent clauses joined by a comma are a comma splice. Keep the semicolon or use a period or a conjunction.
traps.label: comma splice
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Run-on sentences / comma splices, p. 51

traps.comment: consideran más conveniente trabajar = find it more convenient to work. English needs the dummy object it.
traps.label: missing dummy it
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Los responsables del festival anunciaron que habría funciones gratuitas, pero no aclararon si sería necesario reservar entradas con anticipación.
why_this_chunk: funciones = performances / shows; con anticipación = in advance; habría = there would be (sequence of tenses).
suggested_ok_english_hint: funciones / con anticipación / habría: three traps.
english_key: The festival organizers announced that there would be free performances but did not clarify whether tickets would need to be booked in advance.
acceptables: The festival's organizers announced that there would be free shows, but they did not specify whether it would be necessary to reserve tickets in advance.
Those in charge of the festival announced that some performances would be free but did not make clear whether tickets would have to be reserved ahead of time.

traps.comment: funciones (theater) = performances / shows. 'Functions' are roles or receptions.
traps.label: función rendered as 'free functions'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: After a past reporting verb, habría = there would be.
traps.label: will after a past verb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: con anticipación = in advance / ahead of time. 'With anticipation' means eagerly.
traps.label: anticipación rendered as 'with anticipation'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Hasta donde se ha podido comprobar, el error afectó únicamente a los documentos emitidos durante la primera semana de funcionamiento del sistema.
why_this_chunk: Hasta donde = As far as; únicamente = only; emitir documentos = issue.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Hasta donde / únicamente / emitidos: keep the limit on the claim.
english_key: As far as could be determined, the error affected only the documents issued during the first week the system was in operation.
acceptables: As far as it has been possible to verify, the error only affected documents issued during the system's first week of operation.
To the extent that it has been possible to check, the error affected solely the documents issued in the first week of the system's operation.

traps.comment: únicamente limits the scope. Dropping 'only' turns a restriction into a general statement.
traps.label: únicamente omitted (only)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: emitir (documentos) = issue. 'Emit' is for light, gas, or sound.
traps.label: emitir rendered as 'emitted'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Hasta donde se ha podido comprobar = As far as could be determined. 'Until where' is a calque.
traps.label: hasta donde calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: En comparación con el año anterior, se registraron menos incendios, pero la superficie total afectada fue considerablemente mayor.
why_this_chunk: fewer with countable nouns; superficie = area; mayor = larger / greater.
suggested_ok_english_hint: menos incendios / superficie / mayor: three small but costly choices.
english_key: Compared with the previous year, fewer fires were recorded, but the total area affected was considerably larger.
acceptables: In comparison with the year before, there were fewer fires, but the total area burned was considerably greater.
Compared to the previous year, fewer fires were reported, but the total affected area was considerably larger.

traps.comment: superficie (land) = area. 'Surface' is the outer layer.
traps.label: superficie rendered as 'total surface'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: incendios is countable: fewer fires.
traps.label: less with a countable noun
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Collective and mass nouns, pp. 15-16

traps.comment: mayor (size) = larger / greater. 'Major' means important.
traps.label: mayor rendered as 'considerably major'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: De acuerdo con la investigación, la publicación de los datos no causó el problema, aunque sí contribuyó a que se conociera su magnitud.
why_this_chunk: Emphatic sí = did + verb; contribuir a que se conociera = help (to) reveal / make known.
suggested_ok_english_hint: aunque sí contribuyó: what does that sí add? And contribuir a que?
english_key: According to the investigation, the publication of the data did not cause the problem, although it did help to reveal its magnitude.
acceptables: According to the inquiry, publishing the data did not cause the problem, though it did contribute to making its scale known.
According to the research, the publication of the data was not the cause of the problem, although it did help bring its extent to light.

traps.comment: aunque sí contribuyó: the emphatic sí contrasts with the negative. English shows it with did (it did help).
traps.label: emphatic sí dropped
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: contribuir a que + subjunctive = help (to) reveal / contribute to making known. 'Contribute to that' is a calque.
traps.no: contribute to that its magnitude was known
traps.label: contribuir a que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: La cláusula será válida siempre que no contradiga las disposiciones obligatorias que protegen a los consumidores frente a condiciones abusivas.
errors_to_catch: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
why_this_chunk: condiciones abusivas = unfair terms; disposiciones = provisions; siempre que = provided that.
suggested_ok_english_hint: condiciones abusivas / disposiciones / siempre que: three legal-terminology traps.
english_key: The clause will be valid provided that it does not contradict the mandatory provisions that protect consumers against unfair terms.
acceptables: The clause will be valid as long as it does not conflict with the mandatory provisions protecting consumers from unfair conditions.
The clause shall be valid provided it does not contravene the mandatory provisions that protect consumers against unconscionable terms.

traps.comment: condiciones abusivas = unfair (or unconscionable) terms in US consumer law. 'Abusive terms' is EU usage.
traps.label: abusivo rendered as 'abusive terms'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: siempre que / siempre y cuando + subjunctive = provided that / as long as. It is a condition, not 'always' or 'whenever'.
traps.label: siempre que rendered as always / whenever
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: disposiciones (legal) = provisions. 'Dispositions' are temperaments or arrangements.
traps.label: disposición rendered as 'mandatory dispositions'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Por segunda vez en menos de un mes, los residentes tuvieron que abandonar sus viviendas sin saber cuándo podrían regresar.
why_this_chunk: Sequence of tenses: would be able to; Por segunda vez = For the second time.
suggested_ok_english_hint: cuándo podrían: what tense after a past main verb? And Por segunda vez?
english_key: For the second time in less than a month, residents had to leave their homes without knowing when they would be able to return.
acceptables: For the second time in under a month, the residents had to abandon their homes without knowing when they could go back.
For the second time in less than one month, residents were forced to leave their houses not knowing when they would be able to return.

traps.comment: After a past main verb, podrían = would be able to / could.
traps.label: will after a past verb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

traps.comment: Por segunda vez = For the second time. 'By second time' is a calque.
traps.label: por segunda vez calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Lo cierto es que nadie había comprobado si los mapas utilizados para diseñar la ruta seguían reflejando las condiciones del terreno.
why_this_chunk: Lo cierto es que = The truth / The fact is that; seguir + -ndo = still.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Lo cierto es que / seguían reflejando: an opener and a time word.
english_key: The truth is that no one had checked whether the maps used to design the route still reflected conditions on the ground.
acceptables: The fact is that nobody had verified whether the maps used to plan the route still reflected the terrain conditions.
What is certain is that no one had checked if the maps used in designing the route still reflected the conditions of the terrain.

traps.comment: seguían reflejando = still reflected. Without 'still' the time contrast disappears.
traps.label: seguir + gerund omitted (still)
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: Lo cierto es que = The truth / The fact is that. 'The certain is' is a calque.
traps.label: lo cierto calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Si en algún momento se detecta un conflicto de intereses, el evaluador deberá comunicarlo antes de continuar con el análisis de las propuestas.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: en algún momento = at any point; comunicar = disclose / report; si + present.
suggested_ok_english_hint: en algún momento / comunicarlo: two calque traps. And the tense after if?
english_key: If a conflict of interest is detected at any point, the evaluator must disclose it before continuing to analyze the proposals.
acceptables: Should a conflict of interest be detected at any time, the evaluator will have to report it before proceeding with the analysis of the proposals.
If at any stage a conflict of interest is identified, the evaluator must report it before going on with the review of the proposals.

traps.comment: comunicar un conflicto de intereses = disclose / report it. 'Communicate it' is a calque.
traps.label: comunicar rendered as 'communicate it'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: en algún momento = at any point / at any time. 'In some moment' is a calque.
traps.label: en algún momento calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: si (condition) + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: Habiendo recibido las observaciones de los expertos, los organizadores optaron por corregir el folleto en lugar de retirarlo de circulación.
why_this_chunk: optar por + inf. = choose / opt to; retirar de circulación = withdraw.
suggested_ok_english_hint: optaron por corregir / retirarlo: what does English do after 'opt for'? And retirar?
english_key: Having received the experts' comments, the organizers chose to correct the brochure rather than withdraw it from circulation.
acceptables: After receiving the experts' observations, the organizers decided to correct the brochure instead of withdrawing it from circulation.
Having received the comments from the experts, the organizers opted to correct the leaflet rather than take it out of circulation.

traps.comment: optar por + inf. = opted to / chose to (or opted for correcting). 'Opted for correct' is a calque.
traps.label: opted for + bare verb
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: retirar (de circulación) = withdraw. 'Retire' is for people leaving work.
traps.label: retirar rendered as 'retire it'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Mientras no exista una definición compartida de los indicadores, será difícil comparar el desempeño de oficinas que atienden poblaciones muy distintas.
focus: Mientras no = As long as… not
why_this_chunk: desempeño = performance; atender poblaciones = serve; Mientras no = As long as… not / Until.
suggested_ok_english_hint: desempeño vs desempleo / atender / Mientras: three traps.
english_key: As long as there is no shared definition of the indicators, it will be difficult to compare the performance of offices that serve very different populations.
acceptables: Until there is a common definition of the indicators, it will be hard to compare the performance of offices serving very different populations.
As long as no shared definition of the indicators exists, it will be difficult to compare the performance of offices that cater to very different populations.

traps.comment: desempeño = performance. Desempleo is unemployment.
traps.label: desempeño rendered as 'the unemployment'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: atender a una población = serve. 'Attend' means be present at.
traps.label: atender rendered as 'attend very'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Mientras no exista… = As long as there is no / Until there is. 'While' reads as simultaneous time.
traps.ok: As long as there is no
traps.pitfall: Mientras no = As long as… not
traps.label: while for a condition
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: De cada cien solicitudes examinadas, siete contenían errores de identificación y otras doce carecían de documentos indispensables.
why_this_chunk: otras doce = another twelve / twelve others; carecer de = lack (no 'of').
suggested_ok_english_hint: otras doce / carecían de: two calque traps.
english_key: Of every hundred applications examined, seven contained identification errors and another twelve lacked essential documents.
acceptables: Out of every 100 applications reviewed, seven had identification errors and a further twelve were missing indispensable documents.
For every hundred applications examined, seven contained errors in identification, and twelve others lacked essential documents.

traps.comment: otras doce = another twelve / twelve others. 'Other twelve' is a calque.
traps.label: other + number
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: carecer de = lack (transitive). 'Lacked of' is a calque.
traps.label: lacked of
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

spanish_text: La finalidad del registro es permitir que los interesados consulten el estado de sus trámites, no sustituir las notificaciones previstas por la ley.
why_this_chunk: finalidad = purpose; los interesados = interested parties; previsto por la ley = provided for by law.
suggested_ok_english_hint: finalidad / los interesados / previstas por la ley: three legal traps.
english_key: The purpose of the registry is to enable interested parties to check the status of their proceedings, not to replace the notifications provided for by law.
acceptables: The aim of the register is to allow those concerned to consult the status of their applications, not to replace the notifications required by law.
The registry's purpose is to let interested parties check on the status of their procedures, not to substitute for the notifications provided for by law.

traps.comment: finalidad = purpose / aim. 'Finality' means being final.
traps.label: finalidad rendered as 'The finality'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: los interesados (legal) = interested parties / those concerned. 'The interested' is a calque.
traps.label: the interested
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: previsto por la ley = provided for / required by law. 'Foreseen' means predicted.
traps.label: previsto rendered as 'foreseen by law'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: No solo los trabajadores temporales, sino también quienes tenían contratos indefinidos, manifestaron dudas sobre el nuevo sistema de turnos.
why_this_chunk: contrato indefinido = permanent (open-ended) contract; manifestar = express; turnos = shifts.
suggested_ok_english_hint: contratos indefinidos / manifestaron / turnos: three labor-law terms.
english_key: Not only temporary workers but also those with permanent contracts expressed doubts about the new shift system.
acceptables: Not only the temporary workers but also those on open-ended contracts voiced concerns about the new shift system.
Both temporary workers and employees with permanent contracts expressed doubts about the new system of shifts.

traps.comment: contrato indefinido = permanent / open-ended contract. 'Indefinite' suggests vague.
traps.label: indefinido rendered as 'indefinite contracts'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: turnos (work) = shifts. 'Turns' is for games or queues.
traps.label: turno rendered as 'turn system'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: manifestar dudas = express / voice doubts. 'Manifest' means show clearly or appear.
traps.label: manifestar rendered as 'manifested doubts'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Aun si se restableciera el servicio esta misma tarde, los equipos dañados tardarían varios días más en volver a funcionar con normalidad.
errors_to_catch: was for were in a hypothesis
why_this_chunk: Aun si + past subjunctive = Even if… were; equipos = equipment (uncountable); tardar = take (time).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Aun si se restableciera / los equipos / tardarían: three traps.
english_key: Even if service were restored this very afternoon, the damaged equipment would take several more days to return to normal operation.
acceptables: Even if service were restored this afternoon, the damaged equipment would need several more days to work normally again.
Even were the service to be restored later today, it would take several more days for the damaged equipment to function normally again.

traps.comment: equipos (devices) = equipment, an uncountable noun. 'Equipments' is not English; 'teams' changes the meaning.
traps.label: equipos mistranslated
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: tardar varios días = take several days. 'Delay' means postpone.
traps.label: tardar rendered as 'would delay several'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Aun si se restableciera (hypothetical) = Even if service were restored. Formal US English keeps were.
traps.label: was for were in a hypothesis
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

spanish_text: Con independencia de quién financie la restauración, el edificio deberá conservar los elementos originales que le confieren valor patrimonial.
focus: Present tense in future time clauses
why_this_chunk: valor patrimonial = heritage value; Con independencia de = Regardless of; present after who.
suggested_ok_english_hint: valor patrimonial / Con independencia de / financie: three traps.
english_key: Regardless of who finances the restoration, the building must preserve the original features that give it heritage value.
acceptables: No matter who funds the restoration, the building will have to retain the original elements that give it its heritage value.
Irrespective of who pays for the restoration, the building must keep the original elements that confer heritage value on it.

traps.comment: valor patrimonial (building) = heritage value. 'Patrimonial' refers to inherited estate.
traps.label: patrimonial rendered as 'patrimonial value'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Con independencia de = Regardless of / Irrespective of. 'With independence of' is a calque.
traps.label: con independencia de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: con independencia de quién + subjunctive with future reference = English present tense in the time clause, not will.
traps.pitfall: Present tense in future time clauses
traps.label: will in a time clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses: Tense sequence in complex sentences referring to the future, p. 64

spanish_text: La empresa reconoció haber calculado mal los costos iniciales, sin que ello implique necesariamente que hubiera ocultado información a sus socios.
why_this_chunk: Keep necessarily; conceal / hide information from; hubiera ocultado = had concealed.
suggested_ok_english_hint: necesariamente keeps the claim open. And ocultar información a: which preposition?
english_key: The company admitted that it had miscalculated the initial costs, without this necessarily implying that it had concealed information from its partners.
acceptables: The company acknowledged having miscalculated the initial costs, although this does not necessarily mean that it had hidden information from its partners.
The company recognized that it had miscalculated the start-up costs, which does not necessarily imply that it had withheld information from its partners.

traps.comment: necesariamente: dropping it turns 'not necessarily' into a flat denial of concealment.
traps.label: necesariamente omitted
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: ocultar algo a alguien = conceal / hide something from someone.
traps.label: concealed… to
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: The pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera + participle) after a past verb of saying, knowing, or doubting is a plain past perfect in English (had + participle), not would have.
traps.label: would have for had
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Subjunctive mood, p. 55

spanish_text: Ni cuando llegaron las primeras denuncias ni después de la auditoría se adoptaron medidas suficientes para corregir las irregularidades.
why_this_chunk: Neither… nor; a fronted negative triggers inversion (were sufficient measures adopted); denuncias = complaints.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Ni cuando… ni después: a fronted negative. What happens to the verb, and to the second ni?
english_key: Neither when the first complaints arrived nor after the audit were sufficient measures adopted to correct the irregularities.
acceptables: Neither when the first complaints came in nor after the audit were adequate measures taken to correct the irregularities.
Sufficient measures to correct the irregularities were taken neither when the first complaints arrived nor after the audit.

traps.comment: ni… ni = neither… nor. 'Neither… or' is a nonparallel pair.
traps.label: neither paired with or
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: A fronted Neither… nor… requires inversion: were sufficient measures adopted.
traps.label: no inversion after fronted neither
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)
