traps.comment: denuncia = complaint / report. 'Denunciation' is public condemnation.
traps.label: denuncia rendered as 'denunciations'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: A diferencia de lo que sucede con los productos nuevos, los artículos usados pueden presentar señales de desgaste que no constituyen defectos.
why_this_chunk: desgaste = wear; A diferencia de = Unlike.
suggested_ok_english_hint: desgaste: waste? And A diferencia de lo que sucede?
english_key: Unlike new products, used items may show signs of wear that do not constitute defects.
acceptables: Contrary to what happens with new products, used articles may show signs of wear that are not defects.
In contrast with new products, second-hand items can have signs of wear that do not amount to defects.

traps.comment: desgaste = wear (and tear). 'Waste' means garbage or squandering.
traps.label: desgaste rendered as 'signs of waste'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: A diferencia de = Unlike / In contrast with. 'At difference of' is a calque.
traps.label: a diferencia de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

spanish_text: Por último, conviene recordar que una disminución del promedio no significa que todos los participantes hayan mejorado por igual.
errors_to_catch: convenir rendered as 'it is convenient to remember'
por igual rendered as 'improved by equal'
why_this_chunk: Por último = Finally / Lastly (not At last); conviene = it should / it is worth; por igual = equally.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Por último / conviene / por igual: three discourse traps.
english_key: Finally, it should be remembered that a decrease in the average does not mean that all participants have improved equally.
acceptables: Lastly, it is worth remembering that a drop in the average does not mean that all of the participants improved to the same extent.
Finally, it should be borne in mind that a lower average does not mean that every participant has improved equally.

traps.comment: conviene recordar = it should be remembered / it is worth remembering. 'It is convenient' means handy.
traps.label: convenir rendered as 'it is convenient to remember'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Por último (list) = Finally / Lastly. 'At last' means after a long wait.
traps.label: At last for por último
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: por igual = equally / to the same extent. 'By equal' is a calque.
traps.label: por igual rendered as 'improved by equal'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: La testigo, a quien el juez había solicitado que precisara las fechas, reconoció que no recordaba con certeza el orden de los acontecimientos.
why_this_chunk: La testigo = a woman (she); a quien = whom (object of asked); precisar = specify.
suggested_ok_english_hint: La testigo, a quien: who is the witness, and what case is the pronoun?
english_key: The witness, whom the judge had asked to specify the dates, acknowledged that she did not remember the order of events with certainty.
acceptables: The witness, whom the judge had asked to be specific about the dates, admitted that she could not remember with certainty the order of events.
The witness, who had been asked by the judge to clarify the dates, acknowledged that she did not recall the sequence of events with any certainty.

traps.comment: The relative pronoun is the object of its clause, so formal English uses whom.
traps.label: who for whom
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Who and whom, p. 64

traps.comment: La testigo is feminine: she. 'He' changes the person.
traps.label: he for a female witness
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, He/she and gender-specific terms, p. 27

traps.comment: precisar las fechas = specify / clarify the dates. 'Precise' is an adjective.
traps.label: precisar rendered as 'precise the dates'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Fue tal la demanda de entradas que los organizadores tuvieron que añadir una función, aunque inicialmente habían descartado esa posibilidad.
why_this_chunk: Fue tal X que = X was so great that / such was X that; función = performance; descartar = rule out.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Fue tal la demanda que / función / descartado: three traps.
english_key: Demand for tickets was so great that the organizers had to add a performance, although they had initially ruled out that possibility.
acceptables: So great was the demand for tickets that the organizers had to add another show, even though they had initially dismissed that possibility.
The demand for tickets was such that the organizers had to add a performance, although they had originally ruled out that option.

traps.comment: función (theater) = performance / show. 'Function' is a role or a reception.
traps.label: función rendered as 'add a function'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: Fue tal la demanda que = Demand was so great that / Such was the demand that. 'Was such the demand' is a calque.
traps.ok: Demand for tickets was so great
traps.no: Was such the demand for tickets
traps.label: fue tal… que calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: descartar una posibilidad = rule out / dismiss. 'Discard' means throw away.
traps.label: descartar rendered as 'discarded'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: De no haberse producido la interrupción del suministro eléctrico, los investigadores habrían terminado el experimento antes de que venciera el plazo.
focus: If… had, not if… would have
errors_to_catch: De haberse calqued as of having
why_this_chunk: De no haberse + participle = Had… not / If… had not; plazo = deadline.
suggested_ok_english_hint: De no haberse producido: which English if-clause? And plazo?
english_key: Had the power outage not occurred, the researchers would have finished the experiment before the deadline expired.
acceptables: If there had not been a power outage, the researchers would have finished the experiment before the deadline.
Had the electricity supply not been interrupted, the researchers would have completed the experiment before the deadline ran out.

traps.comment: De + perfect infinitive = If… had… / Had…. 'Of having' is a word-for-word calque.
traps.ok: Had the power outage not occurred
traps.no: Of having not occurred the power outage
traps.label: De haberse calqued as of having
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: In an unreal past condition the if-clause takes the past perfect (If X had…), never would have.
traps.ok: Had the power outage not occurred
traps.no: If the power outage would not have occurred
traps.pitfall: If… had, not if… would have
traps.label: would have in the if-clause
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Conditional tenses, p. 23

traps.comment: venciera el plazo = the deadline expired / passed. 'The term expired' suggests a mandate.
traps.label: plazo rendered as 'the term expired'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Quienes afirman que el proyecto fue un fracaso pasan por alto que sus objetivos originales eran más limitados que los anunciados posteriormente.
why_this_chunk: pasar por alto = overlook; more… than; posteriormente = later / subsequently.
suggested_ok_english_hint: pasar por alto / más limitados que / posteriormente: three traps.
english_key: Those who claim that the project was a failure overlook the fact that its original objectives were more limited than those announced later.
acceptables: Those who say the project failed are overlooking the fact that its original goals were more modest than the ones announced subsequently.
People who maintain that the project was a failure ignore the fact that its original objectives were narrower than those that were later announced.

traps.comment: pasar por alto = overlook / ignore. 'Pass by high' is a calque.
traps.label: pasar por alto calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: más… que = more… than. 'That' is a calque of que.
traps.label: more… that
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: posteriormente = later / subsequently. 'Posteriorly' is anatomical.
traps.label: posteriormente rendered as 'announced posteriorly'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Las autoridades señalaron que la información se publicaría tanto en el sitio web como en los tablones de anuncios de las oficinas regionales.
errors_to_catch: tablón de anuncios rendered as 'announcement boards'
why_this_chunk: tablones de anuncios = bulletin boards; both… and; sequence of tenses (would be).
suggested_ok_english_hint: tablones de anuncios / tanto… como / se publicaría: three traps.
english_key: The authorities stated that the information would be published both on the website and on the bulletin boards of the regional offices.
acceptables: The authorities indicated that the information would be posted both on the website and on the bulletin boards at the regional offices.
The authorities pointed out that the information would be published both online and on the regional offices' bulletin boards.

traps.comment: tablones de anuncios = bulletin boards (US). 'Announcement boards' is a calque.
traps.label: tablón de anuncios rendered as 'announcement boards'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

traps.comment: tanto… como = both… and. 'Both… as' is nonparallel.
traps.label: both… as
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Nonparallel constructions, p. 36

traps.comment: After a past reporting verb, se publicaría = would be published.
traps.label: will after a past verb
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Verb tenses, p. 56

spanish_text: El programa está dirigido a personas que hayan perdido su empleo recientemente, no a aquellas que nunca han formado parte del mercado laboral.
why_this_chunk: US labor / program; formar parte de = be part of; dirigido a = aimed at.
suggested_ok_english_hint: mercado laboral and programa: US spelling. And formar parte de?
english_key: The program is aimed at people who have recently lost their jobs, not at those who have never been part of the labor force.
acceptables: The program is intended for people who have recently lost their jobs, not for those who have never been in the labor market.
The program targets people who recently lost their employment, not people who have never belonged to the labor market.

traps.comment: US target: labor, not labour.
traps.label: labour (non-US spelling)
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Non-U.S. usage, p. 37

traps.comment: formar parte de = be part of / belong to. 'Formed part of' is a calque.
traps.label: formar parte calqued
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: dirigido a (audience) = aimed at / intended for. 'Directed to' is a calque.
traps.label: dirigido rendered as 'directed to'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10

spanish_text: Salvo que las partes acuerden otra cosa por escrito, los gastos derivados del traslado correrán a cargo de quien solicite el cambio.
why_this_chunk: Salvo que = Unless; correr a cargo de = be borne by / be paid by; derivados de = arising from.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Salvo que / correrán a cargo de / derivados: contract boilerplate with fixed English forms.
english_key: Unless the parties agree otherwise in writing, the costs arising from the transfer shall be borne by the party requesting the change.
acceptables: Unless the parties agree otherwise in writing, any costs resulting from the relocation will be paid by whoever requests the change.
Except where the parties agree otherwise in writing, the expenses arising from the move shall be borne by the person who requests the change.

traps.comment: Salvo que + subjunctive = Unless (a condition). 'Except that' introduces a fact.
traps.label: except that for a condition
traps.iegs_ref: ATA Explanation of Error Categories (category definition; no IEGS page)

traps.comment: correr a cargo de = be borne by / be paid by. 'Run at the charge of' is a calque.
traps.no: shall run at the charge of
traps.label: correr a cargo de calqued
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Idioms, p. 31

traps.comment: gastos derivados de = costs arising from / resulting from. 'Derived from' is for origins or chemistry.
traps.label: derivado rendered as 'derived from'
traps.iegs_ref: IEGS 2025, Choosing between similar terms and translating cognates, p. 10
